subject: Need this in more states next year

body:
State-level Voting Rights Acts -- like this one in Michigan, or Minnesota's recent law -- are models for other states across the country and exactly the type of pro-voter legislation we need to protect our right to vote everywhere.
Team: Fuel our efforts to support bills like this around the country with $25 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092924_4&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092924_4&amount=25]
9 & 10 News: Michigan Voting Rights Act advances out of committee [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092924_4&amount=25]
Team: The Michigan Voting Rights Act is making good progress toward becoming law. This bill would:
➜ Guarantees in state law protections previously afforded under the 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.
➜ Establishes a nonpartisan election information database.
➜ Requires some local governments to provide alternate language voting materials.
➜ Allows for curbside voting and other assistive services for disabled voters.
This package of bills will reinforce Michigan’s election system and provide clear pathways for those who feel their voting rights are being infringed to right the wrongs that may have stopped them from voting.
Remember: The recent 8th Federal Circuit Court ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
These new laws, if passed in Michigan, would restore those protections and codify them into state law, regardless of how the Supreme Court eventually rules.
Team: We need to pass these bills in Michigan and expand this movement to other states around the country. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass critical pro-voter legislation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092924_4&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

The original Voting Rights Act stands as one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and, even neutered, is still a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With certain courts are still trying to dismantle it piece by piece, we need states to act and protect our right to vote.
We're not the only ones who see it this way. “ Passage of a state voting rights act will have an important deterrent effect and enshrine provisions to prevent new violations from occurring in the first instance ,” said Martin Harris of the Legal Defense Fund. “ Enshrining these provisions into law will further strengthen Michigan’s democracy for all voters and ensure that voters of color have robust protections .”
Governors and state legislatures can act to help solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Team, we need to spread laws like this around the country, from Arizona to Nevada to Georgia. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help expand ballot access and make every vote count nationwide! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092924_4&amount=25]

Hello,
It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.
On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.
At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers.
We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.
The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.
So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.
But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win.
So 5 years after the day that changed my and my brother’s lives, I am asking you to support my pro-democracy movement and protect this seat from my extremist opponent.

Despite several trips to the emergency room, and only after she was unconscious and near death did this young mom finally receive the care that she needed. Women’s lives are literally on the line. It’s time we replace these MAGA extremists with pro-choice leaders who will fight for women and our personal freedoms. That’s why I’m supporting Michelle. Donald Trump and his MAGA allies in the Senate know it, too. **At a recent rally here in Nevada, Trump told his base: "If we win Nevada, we're going to win the whole thing."**

That's why dark money groups like the Koch network are pouring** **_tens of millions of dollars_ into Nevada to flip it red. Now, my campaign is getting pummeled on the airwaves, and expert polling shows me statistically TIED with my extreme, Trump-backed MAGA opponent.

Nevada _always_ comes down to the margins. **The last Senate election here determined the majority and was decided by just 7,928 votes._That's fewer than five votes per precinct._** And we only won because grassroots folks like you stepped up until the very end to power Democrats to victory – $5, $10, and $15 at a time.

---
You’ve been rightfully hearing a lot about swing states like Michigan, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Montana, and Wisconsin. Those are all critical Senate races that Democrats need to win in order to hold our Senate majority. **We’ve also got to pay attention to states like Texas and Maryland too.** **A recent poll showed Rep. Colin Allred within the margin of error in his race to oust Ted Cruz from the Senate.** If we win in Texas, we’ll almost certainly win the Senate. And you know what that means for everything you care deeply about: putting people over billionaires, defending abortion rights, and confirming Supreme Court justices who will uphold your rights — not trample them. **In Maryland, Angela Alsobrooks is gaining momentum after CNN projected Maryland as one of the most likely Senate seats to flip red** — and her opponent, Larry Hogan, has a personal super PAC that's flooded the state with $18 million in vicious attack ads. These two races are also critical to defending the Democratic majority — as a bulwark against MAGA extremism and a force for advancing policies that put working people first. [**If you’re able to make a contribution today, will you split a donation of $28 or any amount between Colin Allred, Angela Alsobrooks, and our re-election campaign?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2721?amount=28&t=8&akid=2358%2E4032634%2Es3BtSq)

Angela Alsobrooks is a lifelong public servant and prosecutor who broke barriers as the first Black woman to serve in multiple senior roles in Prince George’s County. Throughout her career, Angela has focused on supporting families, creating jobs, growing opportunities, investing in education, expanding access to health care, and supporting mental and addiction health treatment. Marylanders will be so fortunate to have her in the Senate. In Texas, Rep. Colin Allred is poised to defeat Ted Cruz and the national MAGA supporters backing him — with enough support from all of us. A fourth-generation Texan raised by a single mom, Colin earned a football scholarship and played 5 years in the NFL — after which he pursued his dream of becoming a civil rights lawyer. He worked for Wendy Davis, served in the Obama administration, and in 2018 defeated a 22-year Republican incumbent to win his seat in the U.S. House. Colin has spent his time in Congress working with both parties to deliver real solutions — lowering prescription drug prices, keeping jobs in Texas, establishing a new veterans medical center, and much more. [**Any contribution you can make right now will boost these two critical campaigns and mine. If you’re able, split a donation between Angela Alsobrooks, Colin Allred, and Warren Democrats to help defend our Senate majority and elect champions for working people across the country.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2721?amount=28&t=14&akid=2358%2E4032634%2Es3BtSq) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

This past week, I held a [press conference](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in front of the Capitol to address some critical findings from a two-year audit of the 2022 election, specifically focused on Douglas County. After a [detailed analysis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), we uncovered several issues that I believe all voters should be aware of:

1. **Remote Wi-Fi Access in Voting Systems:** Despite repeated assurances from public officials that voting machines are not connected to the internet, our investigation confirmed that there are remote Wi-Fi access cards installed in the Douglas County voting system. This is a serious security risk that should concern all of us as it leaves our elections vulnerable to outside interference.
2. **Discrepancies in Undeliverable Ballots:** Our review of records from the USPS and the County Clerk’s office revealed that over 12,000 undeliverable ballots in 11 counties are unaccounted for in the accounting. This raises major questions about the integrity of our mail-in voting process, and we must demand accurate tracking of every ballot.
3. **Insecure Drop Boxes:** The drop boxes used in our elections are not being properly monitored. Poor-quality video footage and cameras that don’t capture necessary details leave us unable to ensure that these drop boxes are secure, and we could not verify if footage was being reviewed post-election as it should be. We need better oversight and real monitoring to protect against potential fraud.

It is deeply frustrating that, despite several major news outlets attending the press conference—including reporters from 9News, the Denver Post, Fox31 and Colorado Public Radio—[not one of them has covered these findings](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The only conclusion I can draw is that they don’t want this information shared, or they don't consider it relevant. However, I believe voters deserve to know the truth.
As we move forward, I am calling on you to take action. Reach out to your county commissioners and county clerk’s office to ask hard questions. Demand answers about the remote Wi-Fi capabilities in voting systems, how undeliverable ballots are being handled, and whether drop boxes are being adequately monitored.
We’re also encouraging citizens to observe the drop boxes (there is training available by [signing up here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)). If our government isn’t going to ensure the integrity of our elections, we should do it.
Thank you for your continued support and commitment to keeping Colorado's elections fair and transparent. Together we can rebuild trust in our voting systems.
God bless you all, and God bless Colorado.
Warm regards, Heidi Ganahl

body:

Derek, it’s Adam with an important update:
My final FEC quarterly deadline of the election is just hours away, and we are so close to hitting our fundraising goal. If everyone reading this email chipped in just $10, we would be set. Will you help us finish these final few hours strong, Derek?
**You can donate through this secure donation link:[secure.actblue.com/donate/sept2024_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240929_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=4&akid=7775%2E5257348%2Eh3pCRq)**
We are living through a transformative moment in our nation’s history. We need leaders who are ready to take on our toughest problems. That’s exactly what I’ve spent my career doing.
When an aluminum company paid smugglers to haul toxic waste and illegally dump it across the border, **I took them to court — and won.** That prosecution set a powerful precedent that no company, big or small, could avoid accountability when harming people and our planet.
When a Republican member of Congress refused to take action in the best interest of our community, I said enough was enough. I stepped up and ran for office against him. **In what was the most expensive House race ever at that time, I defeated the incumbent, flipped the seat blue, and became only the second Democrat to represent the seat in a century.**
When Californians demanded action, I took up their call. **I’ve brought people together** to expand healthcare access for millions of Americans, to lower the cost of prescription drugs, to invest millions of dollars in infrastructure, and to expand affordable housing.
And when Donald Trump threatened to usurp our democracy, I stood up to defend it. I served as the lead Manager for Trump’s first impeachment trial in the Senate — **and together, we secured the first bipartisan vote ever to convict a sitting president.**
I served on the January 6 Committee to investigate the attack Trump incited to overturn the election. I was kicked off the Intelligence Committee by Kevin McCarthy and wore my censure by the MAGA House majority as a badge of honor. **I’ve always done my duty.**
I’m not afraid of rolling up my sleeves to deliver results. I’m ready to continue our shared work in Congress so every Californian can live out their dream — but I can’t do it alone.
**Derek, I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, so I’ll need your help to compete with the GOP’s megadonors. Will you rush in $10 before my end-of-quarter deadline to help bring our fight to the halls of the U.S. Senate? Here’s that personal donation link one more time:**
**[secure.actblue.com/donate/sept2024_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240929_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=5&akid=7775%2E5257348%2Eh3pCRq)**
Thank you!
— Adam

* In **North Carolina** , extreme politicians passed unfair maps that do not represent the people. The far-right state supreme court rubber stamped them. subject: Flipping the Senate is Essential for Trump’sAmerica First Agenda

[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2znvr6brg7ljimuimu18bhiud0b9lk3htet1ucnso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cdge1or0clh2bs)

If we're going to get America back on track, it's going to take more than just electing President Trump.

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, the
Biden/Harris Administration, and the Big Labor bosses are about
to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to launch the next, crucial phase
for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, the Biden/Harris Administration, and Big Labor
to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $100, $200, and
even more. For others, a contribution of $25 or $50 has been as
much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $200, $100,
$50, $25, or $15, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then pitch in with your
contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to the National
Right to Work Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25,
or $15 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive

subject: CT DEMS - Desperation Revealed
body:
Trump Derangement Syndrome in Practice

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/e87ef1bb81b1/red-white-and-blue-party-a-republican-celebration-14759999?e=8763c56857)

** CT DEMS are Just Sad
------------------------------------------------------------

Instead of adequately maintaining their

propaganda site, the CTDEMS reveal two errors:

- A 404 error due to poor content management

- An error in judgment, displaying their ‘Trump Derangement Syndrome’

The sheer incompetence behind placing this error message (see screenshot attached) on the CT DEMs website is staggering. It not only fuels the dangerous rhetoric emboldening potential assassins but also reeks of desperation—desperation born out of fear that the former president—yes, the one they've spent years demonizing—will not just beat one Democratic candidate but two in the same year. That might be a record-breaking achievement.

Perhaps there's no cure for 'Trump Derangement Syndrome,' but at least we can find solace in knowing #45 is on track to become #47.

How do we respond? We should exercise our right to vote, vote early, encourage our friends and family to vote for President Donald J. Trump, and do so with the full knowledge that our fight is a righteous one. God Bless America.

In Liberty,

Dominic Rapini

## At Least 89 Dead as Helene Pounds Southeast
Hurricane Helene caused [at least 89 deaths](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAUheGnwZuty4UAGRi6eEvXjhaG65gKQ4Sprb595czdjvQNR_q_HtPDxRTz89NtZNtSJudbPGi69wJ6lJPsgl2IkERHlmvUGm7AVbfaEMzNaDmT0cEhLjIIp-_KoORSaBO6aBFQwl0ABzAAgzKgcDZq5hwX74lJoBBbqcN3ibmttKTfclAdfNm6ZNfWXjsTHwxHhuN5nkOefaZzv5zheM0LyLWVKsMxxYP6OZUnw3GlRJn6vZW69W_4eQXXaO-rz45rwaXuqg2vM6YUd6WZhOfmYnqft_9THBb_AgAA__88L2C8) this weekend, up to a third of them in North Carolina alone, while leaving over 2 million people struggling without electricity.Helene made landfall Thursday night in Florida's Big Bend region as a Category 4 hurricane, unleashing catastrophic flooding and extensive damage. [See photos here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHO2yAURp8Gb1iXa4LNwNDFW7p2tDBcAhWGCJNYefsqnf_tkz7p6Oj8uW93m3Iqj9_2INND3azr6U2b5hNwlJscvAlESNNARsw4z3ADoYZoKEitwy60Cx4Xr8nuApSVXs2It10PySCgBD2BAFgARrWAwn1RuxAYnCMmgXzqtY1_ayo9Usif-qY2unoM2cTenyebfjFcGa7XdY2u7O57Mly_aIYr6O9eGK7x1VpythCPlKkQf8ba68lDri15yz2dvb1cT7Vw93G5FhpjP_LQjH9eKed0qplJeBw25f8G_eceb4P_AgAA__8x6GLB)The storm caused record-breaking rainfall, particularly in North Carolina, where towns like Biltmore Village experienced severe flooding, submerging the historic area under several feet of water. See [drone footage here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzGPgyAYQH8NbDUfH4g6MDRp3LzlhstNBvRDabA0lmL67y-9uet7yUvezzAONsRwW77sRib7NNoph0Jjd5JwQjUqPhtPhCQ5GdFg00ANQvPVOKKurhuou24m37ZaOFULZYXV4BQqHgwCKugkCIAWoNItaHStdkKgnyZiCmgOOe3VNYVbXsnHVyq0V1PaeDRrzvcHk2eGPcP-OI7qlZ756ejt38TmaWWyL0xeztffpXxfxAAL3818P0KM4aEbpmDZbIj_yfx5sBj8CwAA__8TZVE9).Helene is expected to dissipate by Monday, but heavy rain and flash flooding continue to threaten parts of the Appalachians.
## SpaceX Reaches ISS, but Grounds Rockets
SpaceX's Crew-9 mission successfully launched to the International Space Station for a five-month expedition, enabling the return of stranded NASA astronauts. Watch the [launch video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL8Gtljng8BlYKjUZqnSjmknC-MjpsIhcrCt_H2Vzl3fk570zqfu5FNO18uHn9jVWDofalq5O-wU7FB3Wg4uMiMrya61aC3soTVydGDBIhkiHZA8kDKaIh4o2h7sPpJMDgE1HBS0AATQGAKDPZm-bTGGwEIDD6mWufkp6VpHjvlRVp6bUCaZ3Vjr7S7Ui8CjwOO2bc2jLHXp-emfxNcwCnVchXql5f3z7Uzd9vUtZzfctpRzuhsrNFwmn_Jfsv4_uDr8DQAA__-OVVCp).However, a [post-mission error](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GOqxl4cAuKF5z3b02pcXh5UyEjWWwnfx9lKvTjTTFaD4e48OnnNbXf7-Qa7GMPrR00jgIBQL1qPnkIhGS4uSkRWvhBtLw2fWAVoZJeWOVMba3XhOiuUW0FJ835MkhoIZBgQToATrTg8Fnb55SYgyBmAaaUit791nS2maK-buctHehLDy7ubWtMvWP4Z3h_bqurm4-0K9leH_zl9j8UUlkf6xhpirCTpcYRPQ5lFUMItV6EN_dtF0p51SNZRpei0_5HWl_L58OfwIAAP__ThZYqg) caused the rocket's upper stage to miss its target area during the planned ocean landing, prompting SpaceX to temporarily ground future Falcon 9 launches pending investigation. The two-person crew arrived safely at the ISS on Sunday. They plan to return stranded astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams to Earth in February. Watch the [docking video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL_GbFjHQbEZGLpkS9eOFoZzci02kaF2-_dVM3d70hue3vt1ugbOvN3ewkq-LWUKsfFBk5MaJJrJiOQXIiQtyKsBhwFeQFlx9wjaLrNLgUZQg6OYAhk1WxuCM6i1YI-ABpwGBTAC9HYEi_NoZ6VwiZE6A5S4lb3_KLy1Oy35pxy097GsIvt7a4_a6dcOLx1ezvPs6yNE-rMdXp78LeNOp3Qy1LaXLXw1uXKtXDbJtcpU4idvN7H79Dg5Z6526Azc1sD5GWn_Lx8efwMAAP__BVlZ-A).This marks the [third time in recent months](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu8yAUBeCnwRvR9YVgMzD8i7f8a0cLw8WmxcYCkrRvX6VSt25n-KRzdN5u883GFI_1v93JtJBn61p80Ky5AI5ylp03gQhJdGT6AYcBrtCrbjNOXK3yTgrwFkZa9GB7vaCUo9DKk-6iQUAJWkAPMAJc1AgKl1EtfY_BOWISyMeWy-U9x6NtFNJXflC5uLx3yWytnZWJfwwnhlM9raOQ4rq1Iz9fhOH0KmA4gX5l_as--Vry_fCVx1Z5sMnlg5fsPqjxkIgat6FR4ffzpMJrsyvxPdYQCzGcumL8-YwpxaoGJmHdbUw_k9rfBz0MfgcAAP__zXtoTQ) that SpaceX has temporarily halted launches.
## Kris Kristofferson Dies at 88
Kris Kristofferson, the country music legend and Hollywood actor, [died on Saturday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGP4yAQhX8N7ojGYwdIQXGNu1x7pYVhSOYWGwuIo_z7lbfe5klPn_T09P27z3fHibfHX7eSbTHPzjc-aL7JASSO89gFG4mQho5sr1FruEKvuqc1g49xUUGN_hqBYlBAg9Z-McabuOiOLQKOcBugBzAAF2VA4WLU0vcYvScxAgVuuVz-Z97ak2L65IPKxee1S_bZ2l7F8EfgJHA6XGFqn5MJnM5lgVPkdLa8cHudvMqd8p5IbvSuAqevwlWe0XKMVGreZCAXpM-vrZWPXF-VvUz0oC1I51sussdB9dfbqFHg1BUb9jenxFVpMcJjdZx-7rXfZR0WvwMAAP__9SltCg) at his home in Hawaii at the age of 88.Kristofferson was a groundbreaking singer-songwriter who penned hits like _[Me and Bobby McGee](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzGLtDAQQH9N0q1MZmLUIsUHH8IVe-1ylcQ4rjniRjQb2X9_7NXXvgcP3u06XF2I4XH_dCvbPKfB-RwKD92F4IJ60HKyMzMySbaqwaaBGpSRi2VQ3hMp5etunrA29diOAKRpMuRqI4NFQA0dgQJoASrTgsGxNaNSOHvPQgNPIae9-k7hkRee4ysV3iufVhntkvN2CPonsBfYn-dZvdIzP0d--zdx2S-C-iLov1u2j7Df4ChfcrfTdoYYw2EaoeG-uhB_k_nvwWLxJwAA__8hvFG-)_ and _Sunday Morning Coming Down_ , and later found success as an actor, starring in films such as _A Star Is Born_.He was inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 2004 and received a Lifetime Achievement Award from the Recording Academy in 2015. [See his life in photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOhCAURb8GOs3jyYAUFNvYzbZbGkceM-wiGGQ0_v3Grbe5xc3JSc7XfbxPIYb0_JwWstXncZpr2Gk0TQcNylFyZz0RUsfJCo1aww2E4i8L2nmDSvSabhqMJifJGWfEQ_egEHiwCCjBdCAAeoBWXf-jVw8h0M8zMQnkQs2l_c4h1Rf5eOadSjvnhUf7qnXdWPfBcGA4HMfRHsFRXinN-Z1qOS-O4fBTwtZcU7P3VLacmjO_05PhwIt16xFiDJvSTMJzmUL809f_Y3eLvwEAAP__oj1XnQ).

# [CBS says it will NOT fact-check candidates during VP debate. Demand they reverse this terrible decision](https://default.salsalabs.org/T69d68f68-292b-4708-ab0e-42eb94a8aff8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | CBS now says it will NOT fact-check candidates during the VP debate this week—even for patently obvious lies. Meaning JD Vance can spew a stream of blatant BS with no pushback whatsoever from the moderators. [**Add your name, and demand CBS reverse this horrible decision.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8c5b8a02-d5c2-49b6-a85b-49d8c7c75459/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) What the hell is the point of having moderators if they're just going to sit there and say nothing about obvious lies? CBS says it will be up to the candidates to do it. But it shouldn't be Tim Walz's responsibility to use his limited time to do the moderators' job for them. Worse yet, CBS actually has a "misinformation unit" that will be doing the fact checking and posting it on a blog, where approximately zero people will see it. Why not give this content to the moderators so they can present it to the debate audience during the actual debate? [**Don't let CBS do this unchallenged. Demand they practice actual journalism, fact-check the VP debate, and not let Vance tell lie after lie unchallenged.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T90d1206d-323b-4200-9398-4eae73e24d52/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

## Chaos At Monster Truck Event

In response, Reid [went on a rampage](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OqzAQxfGnMZ2RPRAbChe3octtt0SDPQQr5kP2JCT79Ktsv-VPpzn6f13HK8YUt9t_XMnxa95H9ByfNPayURLasa2Cm1TodUVOW7Cm76yGanGI-mI8oJ1aY7Ez1nfKdIpmHTBMMFfRgYJW9Y3S6mLA1trjpbG-932YpxYa0SoKkfdc80JMLyxzeu9PyrXf1yq5hfkoovknYBAwnOdZ37msn1HAsNFZBAwgl70ckTHFbwpSS8yZClOQODNliSnRjYJc9618zPnh7xJLwUdiiSwzhY38vcgz8iIPfPvlQwFDlV04zphSLMaKVt1WjOn3Gv9R6ungJwAA__-1yG7x) with his truck, running over a Jeep and hitting five people, two of whom required hospitalization. subject: The writings of Thich Nhat Hanh
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
Friends, family, and supporters:
Like many, many others writing to you today, on the final day of the third quarter fundraising period before the FEC deadline, I’m going to ask you to support my re-election campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024] , if you’re able.
But first, if you’ll indulge me, I want to share the opening lines of a poem I’ve long enjoyed. It’s written by Thich Nhat Hanh, a Vietnamese Thiền Buddhist monk, activist, author, teacher, poet, and a good soul who I was honored to meet before he passed away at age 95 in 2022.
They don’t publish
the good news.
The good news is published
by us.
What a beautiful reminder that WE are responsible for — and capable of — creating and “publishing” the good news of the world.
Rarely has that been more true in the political sphere than in this election. We are faced with a very clear choice between joy and fear. Between unity and division. Between freedom and control.
I’m incredibly glad to be working day in and day out to choose joy, unity, and freedom — to publish the good news. If you’re with me, I hope you will remember that what we do right now — supporting candidates we believe in, voting, canvassing and phone banking, donating when we can — is what will make the difference come November.
Today is a big deadline in my re-election campaign, and I’m humbly asking for your help. Will you contribute any amount to support my team’s efforts to “publish the good news” and keep Virginia blue?
You can give online at this link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thank you!
Talk soon,
Tim
P.S. You can read the full poem here [https://pollycastor.com/2020/02/17/the-good-news-poem-by-thich-nhat-hanh/] .

[**Can you split a donation of any amount to Seth Moulton and my campaign to keep us out of a real jam?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93885222/501951862/1467451018?refcode=240930_Tester&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODM5N2RjNC0yNDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1eCFFAJcJvdbxvMZfGWaNSHgcCaOhVqXeqQO7KXkMcQ=) Listen—jokes aside, I don’t expect you to chip into every email. I know how hard you work and I always appreciate your support,_especially when our campaign needs it most._ Right now, we’re facing a significant shortfall in fundraising. And a few hours is not a lot of time to make up for it. If we’re going to overcome the $90 million Mitch McConnell is spending against me, I need your help. | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only __**36 days**__ until Election Day, and votes are already being banked. Vote-by-mails are being returned to the Board of Elections offices as the Early Voting period approaches. We are well on our way to a successful Nov. 5th. Your efforts now will help make it happen, please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs. This past week, Kean for Congress launched our new ad, attended in-district events, launched labor walks, and increased our voter contacts. We have the momentum, and our opponent's campaign is running on fumes. If we can outperform her on the ground this week and next, the democrats will fully jump ship on her chances, leaving us a clear path to run up the score. For most of this week, Tom was in Washington, wrapping up his Congressional work ahead of the fall recess. Tom attended committee meetings and mark-ups, met with constituents and advocacy groups, and kept his word to keep the government and America open and funded. Our Field Team organized new volunteers and ensured our local campaign partners on the ground had the resources they needed for our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts. We hosted our weekly phone banks, doubled down on our door-to-door canvassing, and partnered with our fantastic partners in labor for a blitz of Union County - the first of many more in the coming weeks. We put up some impressive numbers you can more read about below. | | **✅ Kean Constituent Services Return Over $10 Million to NJ-07 Residents ✅**
---
| | This past week, Tom announced that his constituent services team has officially recovered over __**$10,000,000**__ in benefits for residents across District 7.

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There are only 36 days until Election Day, and votes are already being banked. Vote-by-mails are being returned to the Board of Elections offices as the Early Voting period approaches. We are well on our way to a successful Nov. 5th. Your efforts now will help make it happen, please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or make yard signs. This past week, Kean for Congress launched our new ad, attended in-district events, launched labor walks, and increased our voter contacts. We have the momentum, and our opponent's campaign is running on fumes. If we can outperform her on the ground this week and next, the democrats will fully jump ship on her chances, leaving us a clear path to run up the score. For most of this week, Tom was in Washington, wrapping up his Congressional work ahead of the fall recess. Tom attended committee meetings and mark-ups, met with constituents and advocacy groups, and kept his word to keep the government and America open and funded. Our Field Team organized new volunteers and ensured our local campaign partners on the ground had the resources they needed for our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts. We hosted our weekly phone banks, doubled down on our door-to-door canvassing, and partnered with our fantastic partners in labor for a blitz of Union County - the first of many more in the coming weeks. We put up some impressive numbers you can more read about below. This week, Kean for Congress comms highlighted our opponent's , her work to while leading the progressive Working Families Party, and her rhetoric. The Altman agenda will make our communities less safe and will have dangerous consequences if she wins. We can't let that happen, and just wait to see what we have lined up this week 😮. Follow us on social media so you don't miss out! Most vote-by-mail voters should have received their ballots this past week. Please make sure to check your mailbox for your ballot, complete it and send it back by using either a secure dropbox, the U.S. Postal Service, or by delivering it to your county Board of Elections. Please make sure to complete your ballot and return it before November 5th. Questions? . Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! P.S.: Lawn signs are moving fast, to request a Kean for Congress lawn sign now while you can! | | | | | | | 🚔 NEW AD - "KEEP US SAFE" 🚔 | | 🚨 Our newest ad "Keep Us Safe" was released this week. Have you seen it on TV yet? 🚨 The ad highlights Tom's steadfast support of the law enforcement community, and his work in Washington to secure over millions in federal funding for projects including upgrading equipment and infrastructure for law enforcement. The ad also covers Tom’s work sponsoring legislation to stop the rise in car thefts, and prevent dangerous drugs like fentanyl from pouring onto our streets. ⬇️ WATCH THE AD ⬇️ | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Constituent Services Return Over $10 Million to NJ-07 Residents ✅ | | This past week, Tom announced that his constituent services team has officially recovered over $10,000,000 in benefits for residents across District 7. I know Tom, and if there is one thing I can point to in his work that he is most proud of, it is his constituent services operations. From hosting mobile office hours in all 95 town, to his pop-up offices, and their constant efforts at public fairs and events, Tom and his government team are always fighting to ensure resident casework concerns are being address timely towards positive resolutions. “I am committed to serving my district to ensure every constituent receives the benefits and assistance to which they are entitled.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | After returning from D.C., Tom made stops in Westfield to cut the ribbon at the Greek Festival, Rahway for the Republican BBQ and a Labor Walk Launch, and Bridgewater** for our annual Beer & Chili Fest. Now that Tom's work in Washington is done through November, he will be all across the district every day speaking with voters and attending events. The Field Team coordinated with our municipal lawn sign captains to finalize the sign-blitz plan, scheduled upcoming door launches, and onboarded new volunteers. They spent much of the other time making volunteer calls, door knocking and phone banking with our grassroots teams. Our door knocking program covered towns like Frenchtown, Lambertville, Clinton, Raritan Township, Readington, Bridgewater, Bernards, Bedminster, Warren Township, Green Brook, Somerville, Long Hill, Mount Olive, Mendham Township, Springfield, Westfield, Berkeley Heights, New Providence, Hackettstown, Sparta, Phillipsburg Washington, Lopatcong, Hopatcong, and Mansfield ! We held our first of many-to-come labor walks with our partners from the Eastern Atlantic States Regional Council of Carpenters, who showed up to help get Tom over the finish line. Together, they knocked on thousands of doors in mere hours, and we are grateful for their support and GOTV efforts. Tom will continue to have the back of our labor unions and ensure their priorities are address in Washington. Labor and Tom Kean - perfect together. Our scheduled launches in the coming weeks will cover Scotch Plains , Mountainside , Summit , Washington Township , Raritan Township , Washington Borough , Somerville, Bernards, Bernardsville, Sparta, Lopatcong and more. We hope to see you there. Our weekly door goal is increasing significantly next week, and we must make sure we are doing everything we can to reach the voters we need to. Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with two organized phone banks this week - Union, and Somerset. This week we were able to call over 13,000 voters across all six counties. The phone banks and the work of our remote callers is producing real results and valuable voter contacts, as well as chasing outstanding vote-by-mail ballots to be returned. We have a minimum of two to three phone banks a week that you can join from now until Election Day! This number will increase as our county organizations launch their vote-by-mail chase efforts. It’s Jon Tester. Today is the most important day of my campaign so far. #

Today is the most important day of my campaign so far. I’ll explain more, but first: **[Can you rush a split donation to help me hit my FEC fundraising goal and win 2024’s most important Senate race?](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=c4770c6751ec467d8803380cc248b5c7&_e=o3X6mw26enEZgpQhtoXSFt40pR5topzfunmjixhVBRFsLkIccQlN1mTV1kZpD1US1Rk99CtpUwCrkvzjOFLYfUYV8cZ92JkFAVtWMqUu_FOQVwbqpfcSLcI0DtUA71iitnPWLCJDohKb1iO9_i_acG9s9B_WHTL2DOjOr2iBaQSMBFSNxF7m5dIHvFgfgZcAWgAW_29G9ZNLkTdpFdUXPUBjMFX-Ft84THIQ_YDqFqV4nwa7mgENc32UU7lqLuiRHKV-CBTGjc2XMY6WoLQ1WWcUF-UJabVllqUFUlAT2oEVAVFfb-l9QszX50f1f5bV_HsbKnxQHScLU4Fxb7kzDQ8208QfF8td9YTxdL1fOU-E71gMFVEbUHvDuqd7FWcBSpF-zNELytATVXReXQ6mL7bt4RGbTZs5rnCm8X8AS1A%3D)** I’ll get right to it, Peter. Here’s the two most important things for you to know. Tonight, I’ll step on stage for my second and final debate with Tim Sheehy, and show Montanans exactly why they can’t trust a wealthy out-of-stater who doesn’t know a lick about Montana values. Immediately afterwards, my campaign has our final end-of-quarter FEC deadline of the entire election. | | Dear Fellow Conservative,

"One of the biggest threats to America's politics might be the country's founding document."

That's what a despicable New York Times article said about the U.S. Constitution.

The leftist media has always been hostile to the American founding. But they've rarely been this direct about it.
---
|
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=43e6d53cd2334b939e7d4e673700c695&_e=EyGNXhu2ecWLV7QLFnt-689igRhgBPVzbHMoKrxBiAoERrRZdI0s3Y32XK-zkXjYu4yFOHOxv6gWJpPlps1O3pJGU7tRyLYaUqZN2KVkDiH2HlhVbLdWTPWnpTO8Evla6QdTUEAZc-jSapHCym_mnBbbXD5a2RwBpTtjoJgDBwt8aEHsAZ8zhRL3LGId7mQEUCSujIyIk3LlnLszLj0m18AjG8xHYkvCU3U90xszNtcA_Dqq4FjDk92RBw2Z-g1LjAXb-UCDAYfBAkdrHaIYQ4jlpew_GSTUh7YkA0RzkhchBZ18h7QHaUXAmPsAZ6x-YO22PJnaH38RG52GUtiytOf-5O46SxxPymOYZscgKZM%3D)

| | Today, so many Americans don't understand our founding principles and think they are bad for our country's survival and prosperity.

**That 's why I'd like to offer you a free digital copy of [The Heritage Foundation's _Guide to the Constitution_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=43e6d53cd2334b939e7d4e673700c695&_e=EyGNXhu2ecWLV7QLFnt-689igRhgBPVzbHMoKrxBiAoERrRZdI0s3Y32XK-zkXjYu4yFOHOxv6gWJpPlps1O3pJGU7tRyLYaUqZN2KVkDiH2HlhVbLdWTPWnpTO8Evla6QdTUEAZc-jSapHCym_mnBbbXD5a2RwBpTtjoJgDBwt8aEHsAZ8zhRL3LGId7mQEUCSujIyIk3LlnLszLj0m1_gNIxYRQo__K_3Rxne6n90K5k6TPwROYmW9jY5byIyUySnvVsddbjRHCbr3di4oYlgDnlZ41jedQa8oPMN-eKrsG0T9AfyKwStEF8G293Re-vQuopRlZY47ZfKa26Pjd9weHGZ0cLSrZYx651Bi47Q%3D).**

In this digital interactive guide, you'll discover:

* Detailed analysis of every clause and amendment in the Constitution.
* Insights from over 100 constitutional scholars and legal experts, including Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Ed Meese.
* A thorough review of what the Constitution _actually says_ and discussion of how it applies today.
* Copies of the Constitution and the foundational documents that shaped it.

**You can get instant access to your FREE guide now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/constitution](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=43e6d53cd2334b939e7d4e673700c695&_e=EyGNXhu2ecWLV7QLFnt-689igRhgBPVzbHMoKrxBiAoERrRZdI0s3Y32XK-zkXjYu4yFOHOxv6gWJpPlps1O3pJGU7tRyLYaUqZN2KVkDiH2HlhVbLdWTPWnpTO8Evla6QdTUEAZc-jSapHCym_mnBbbXD5a2RwBpTtjoJgDBwt8aEHsAZ8zhRL3LGId7mQEUCSujIyIk3LlnLszLj0m1xKC4Aj4t--QvYTJP3z7Kn_potFMnkd8il0rWsQkJGqgEz-WFUWjG-azmUA6Fd7B4tp8BfJ2DszzTFaDo13L9VuV3D7RnQxUSmINrgKkjqBqaCqsHClF_qNoGArGF-AHpaE2JWfC4OUGMRZBwereU1U%3D).**

I hope this free resource reminds you that the Constitution isn't a threat to America. It's our greatest asset. Sincerely,

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.
President, The Heritage Foundation

subject: Jim Jordan is a national disaster. Only our national movement can stop him.
body:

Friends,
Remember Mark Robinson?
He’s the Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina and the Republican nominee for governor who wants to impose an extreme national abortion ban and take us back to a time when women couldn’t even vote.
Sound familiar?
That’s because he’s cut from the same ULTRA-MAGA cloth as Jim Jordan – who routinely leads efforts from House Republicans to attack WOMEN.
This is not just about a couple of bad politicians. This is the face of Republican national leadership – and Jim Jordan is their henchman.
Whether it’s repeating harmful lies about his own constituents or pushing such radical abortion laws even his own ULTRA-MAGA cronies don’t support them, Jim Jordan is right in the center of every awful policy we see Republicans push in Congress.
Jim Jordan is a national disaster and it’s going to take a national movement to stop him! This is what I mean when I say that our race is the most important congressional race in the country.
We are down to the wire on our final quarterly fundraising deadline and the fundraising numbers we post will send a message that cannot be ignored. I need your help to make this our biggest fundraising month yet and get our fight to take down Jim Jordan on the national stage. Will you donate $50, $100, $500 or more right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240930_mark_robinson_link1]
TAKE DOWN JIM JORDAN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240930_mark_robinson_button1]
Jordan’s vision for America is one where our freedoms are sacrificed for his political gain. His arrogance is so huge that he’s even resorted to buying the support of the people who previously opposed his run for Speaker of the House – all so he can make another grab for the gavel.
But Jim Jordan has never faced an opponent as strong as our campaign and for the first time in his career, he’s running scared!
This is SUCH a big deal. Jordan has NEVER had to buy yard signs let alone TV ads before he ran against me.
This guy is so arrogant and rude, let me tell you what I hear from people in our district who’ve been subjected to a visit from Jim Jordan:
I’m a total foodie, so I love going to local restaurants. I hear from all of the wait staff how rude Jordan is to them. He talks down to people and treats them dismissively.
Defeating Jim Jordan means sending a clear message that Ohio and America won’t stand for ULTRA-MAGA nastiness anymore! We’re all set with that, thank you!
Join our national fight today and together we will stop Jim Jordan and END his political career! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240930_mark_robinson_link2]
Let’s finish strong,
Tamie Wilson

name: Jill Stein
subject: Is this you?“Persistently sad and hopeless”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
We need to take a moment to address this crisis.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=1)
---
Peter,

Before we close out Suicide Prevention Month, I need to take a breath from the frantic pace of this sprint to election day to talk about a serious public health crisis – one I would even classify as a new pandemic.

This is not a random aside. It’s an issue that cuts directly to the heart of our work and the reasons I am running for president.

**I’ll get right to the point: There is a sprawling, spiraling mental health crisis consuming this country, and our young people are at the very center of the storm.

** The most notable trends emerged during the pandemic. In 2022, data from the CDC found that 44% of teens in the US reported feeling _“persistently sad and hopeless.”

_ That number is indeed alarming. But we should note that even in 2019 that figure sat at 37%.

While many have tried to write this off as a pandemic-related fluke, the problem is much much deeper than the temporary isolation we experienced in that time.

In fact, new data from 2024 (as reported in Forbes) shows that, if anything, this trend has gotten worse.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=2)
---
The causes of this crisis are hardly unknown to us.

The social isolation brought on by **the pervasive struggle to survive in modern society** – the feeling fact that even the necessities of life are increasingly unaffordable and harder to hold on to.

The rising climate emergency, and the clear signs that **none of your elected leaders take these threats to human survival seriously**.

The grim realization that **your vote only matters if you’re rich** enough to buy their attention.

None of this is artificial and none of it is accidental. The conditions of late stage capitalism are designed to leave us “persistently sad and hopeless” such that we surrender to this fate.

**But we do NOT surrender! Our campaign is about rising up against the elite political and commercial forces conspiring to keep us compliant and silent in their destruction of humanity.

[We will show the strength of that movement at the ballot box on November 5th. Will you donate now to help us reach the millions of still undecided voters?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=4)
---
As a medical doctor, I know firsthand the devastating toll that mental health strain takes on our physical well being. When every single day feels like a battle to endure, your body pays the price.

I’m particularly alarmed by the rapid rise in mental health crisis among our youth. Not only will this shorten their lifespans, it threatens the very foundations of our democracy when young people disengage from our political process.

We absolutely need comprehensive mental health resources, and we will have that under **[my plan for universal free healthcare](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=5)**.

But while those services are urgently needed, they will not address the root cause.

The simple and hard truth is that the mental health crisis engulfing our nation is rooted in a society and economic system designed to enrich the very few at the expense of the many, and it will not change until we overthrow that system.

Until we address the underlying cause of structural inequality and rebuild our economy to serve ALL of humanity, mental health will continue to be a source of struggle for billions of us.

If this message has resonated with you in a particular way, there is something important I need you to know:

You are not alone.

I’m going to repeat that, because it’s SO important that you know this on a fundamental level:

_YOU. ARE. NOT. ALONE.

_ There are millions of us – billions even – walking the same path and struggling under the same crushing weight.

**In those moments where you may feel that the world is too much for you, I dearly hope you know that an entire community stands with you, ready to lift you up.** If you or someone you love is struggling with persistent feelings of hopelessness, please call 988 or visit **[988lifeline.org](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=1LmCVB9f5dQnG5ZQj8uyUrhjKLVus03gzAC05u5XUjg&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=suicide_prevention_month&n=6)** for resources and community.

Above all else, please know that you are worthy, you are treasured, and you are so urgently needed in our collective fight.

With love, solidarity, and gratitude,

Jill

body:
The NRA fumbled. We're scoring big. Here's the play-by-play.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240930-1&t=1&akid=1242%2E587540%2Ef4aF0s)
Peter, the NRA is in trouble. 🤭
Former NRA CEO, Wayne LaPierre, was banned from working at the NRA and affiliate organizations for 10 years after being found guilty of financial mismanagement.
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em20240930-1?refcode=em20240930-1&refcode2=1242_587540_f4aF0s&akid=1242%2E587540%2Ef4aF0s)**
**In other words, he was stealing money from NRA supporters.**
**[Peter, that's not something we do. Every donation we receive is invested back into the organization and our candidates. Can you give $5 before tonight's end-of-quarter deadline to support our work to elect young leaders across the country?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em20240930-1?refcode=em20240930-1&amount=5&refcode2=1242_587540_f4aF0s&akid=1242%2E587540%2Ef4aF0s)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em20240930-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240930-1-1242&refcode2=1242_587540_f4aF0s&akid=1242%2E587540%2Ef4aF0s)**
I'm sending Wayne my deepest thoughts and prayers, and I hope that he can continue to afford rent without his side hustle.
Unlike the NRA, we're using our contributions to invest in our mission: **elect young progressive leaders up-and-down the ballot.**
This year, we invested $300,000 in Molly Cook's campaign and helped her become the youngest and most progressive member of the Texas State Senate. And, our investment in Oscar De Los Santos’ campaign helped him clinch the primary election by a reassuring margin. (Oscar might just be on track to be the youngest Speaker of a state house in the country 😁🎉)
**[Peter, we invest contributions back into our candidates. Can you rush a contribution of $5 ahead of the end-of-quarter fundraising deadline at midnight tonight to help us build a progressive future? We promise you your contribution won’t be used to pay for a private plane. 😉](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em20240930-1?refcode=em20240930-1&amount=5&refcode2=1242_587540_f4aF0s&akid=1242%2E587540%2Ef4aF0s)**

Thank you,
**David Hogg**
Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

I’m just reaching out to make sure that you didn’t miss Kristan’s recent email!

We’re just days away from the deadline for _Students for Life Action’s_ **$125,000 End of Quarter Matching Challenge** opportunity.

With everything on the line in November, your support is so important to helping us reach our goal.

**[So, please agree to your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ $125,000 End of Quarter Matching Challenge right away](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/SjvKX0lO-5t7jsOl_qQBSw~~/AAVkMwA~)!**

As you’ll see in the email below, so much is at stake this November for mothers and preborn babies.

We need to do everything possible to FIGHT BACK against the Abortion Lobby’s scheme to seize total control of Washington, D.C. and then force late-term abortion on every state in the country.

Thank you for taking a courageous stand for Life!

For Life,

Tina Whittington
Vice President, _Students for Life Action_

_\---------- Begin Forwarded Message ----------_
Dear Peter,

Check out this recent headline I read in _The Hill:_ [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/FmKGxnpKJGeKz2vgP5yJPg~~/AAVkMwA~_an-mZXPH_HUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) It definitely sounds bad.

But what they _actually_ want is even worse:
● All pro-life laws across the country wiped out _(even those simply requiring an abortionist to communicate with a minor's parent before they can prey on their daughter);_
● Abortion through all nine months of a pregnancy forced on every state in the country; and
● All paid for by taxpayers like you and me.
Peter, this is why it’s so important _Students for Life Action_ ramps up all of our Election Year Programs so we can get ahead of this madness . . . **before it’s too late.**

**[The good news is, one very generous supporter just agreed to match – dollar-for-dollar – every contribution _Students for Life Action_ supporters can give by the upcoming September 30th End of Quarter Deadline up to $125,000](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/htpt9qs3NEwb8dHavXvc7Q~~/AAVkMwA~_an-mZXPH_HUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~).**

As the last End of Quarter deadline before Election Day, it’s so critical we’re able to take advantage of this match!

The good news is, _Students for Life Action_ has been on the ground over the past several months fighting for the preborn and stopping the Abortion Lobby’s attempt at a total takeover.

Some of our specific, critical Election Year Programs you may have heard of that we’re running at full blast right now include:
**> >> _Canvasser Door Knocking_** in key Battleground States across the nation. We’ve found it is the most effective way to convert pro-abortion/on-the-fence voters into PRO-LIFE FIRST voters!

Our young canvassers put in long, hard days of work knocking on doors, informing voters, converting them into Pro-Life First voters, and sometimes are even attacked by pro-abortion radicals whom they encounter.

Our students will personally knock on hundreds of thousands of doors and even collaborate with homeschool groups and church communities to expand our reach!

**> >> _The Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour_** where our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** is screening the pro-life movie, _Unplanned,_ on dozens of college campuses in SEVEN hotly contested states that WILL decide 2024, including:
| |
---|---
\- Arizona* | \- Montana*
\- Florida* | \- North Carolina
\- Michigan | \- Pennsylvania
\- Missouri*
_* Abortion ballot referendum state_

This movie is one of the most powerful tools the Pro-Life Movement has right now for turning young people against abortion, as many pro-abortion/on-the-fence students who watch it have their eyes opened to the evils of abortion.

**> >> _Blasting our 2024 Referendum Battleplan_ ,** which includes our dedicated student activists conducting critical voter outreach programs using key election materials to turn out the pro-life vote! Materials like:

**-_Ballot Referendum Kits_ –** which we’re using to educate voters and help push back against ballot initiatives undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country!

**-_Yard Signs_ –** which we’re handing out to pro-lifers in Referendum States so they can be placed in thousands of yards to spread the pro-life message far and wide!

These programs would not be possible without your support and could not be more important.

**So, please agree to your most generous contribution of:**

**> > [$1,000 _(which instantly doubles to $2,000!)_](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/8qqyNOz6nwAzBS0OKzdEPw~~/AAVkMwA~_pmVzx_x1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

**> > [$500 _(which instantly doubles to $1,000!)_](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/1RnEM9-k3O-9__kFFV1sxw~~/AAVkMwA~)**

**> > [$250 _(which instantly doubles to $500!)_](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/fQMBTAQ6mqiZzCKpibWQiQ~~/AAVkMwA~)**

**> > [$100 _(which instantly doubles to $200!)_](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/HRG0gjs7QvWNHwH0-3IXnA~~/AAVkMwA~)**

**> > [$50 _(which instantly doubles to $100!)_](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/ytQMTybTLPbPV9mhjQZJbg~~/AAVkMwA~_pmVzx_x1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

**[Even a gift of just $25 _(which instantly doubles to $50)_ would be a huge help](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/RJ3wI8y9qal8-qd0erdRDw~~/AAVkMwA~_pmVzx_x1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)!**

As the ONLY National Pro-Life organization targeting young voters, keeping our programs running at **_FULL BLAST_** is going to be critical to stopping the Abortion Lobby.

I just need your help to keep it all going!

Peter, now more than ever we need to stand up for Life at the ballot box.

**[So, can I count on you to please take advantage of this $125,000 Matching Challenge](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/FR2G1KHmjpzdp3J2u7jHbQ~~/AAVkMwA~_an-mZXPH_HUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)?**

There won’t be a better time to give before November.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z51bini5svhob0e7b9p9fugrm1370fodkuuabjp0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cti6eob2cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z09ngop7kt6pjlgqqp4lt034q6i190118lo2mh80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cti6eob2cjh2bs)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn8fv0dckcqb19u3n4kau82aqctrp8i2tun17hd8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cti6eob2cjh2bs)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3vbfulahtntu2kbeicb4i860ejkia1pd7rroq5g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cti6eob2cjh2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

American Action News

| Hi—

You already know that climate's on the ballot this November.

And, as an Evergreen follower, you already know that Kamala Harris and Donald Trump are as different as sunshine and crude oil on this issue.

**Yet, research indicates that there are _millions_ of Americans who care about climate change but are not yet engaged in politics.**

This means that we have a critical opportunity right now to help our friends, family members, and colleagues understand what's at stake—and take action at the ballot box.

With early voting already beginning in several states, **right now is a critical time to talk to people in your life about how a Harris-Walz presidency could save us from a Trump-Vance climate disaster and instead build a safer future where we reduce climate pollution by as much as 24 percent by 2030.**

That's why we teamed up with the Sunrise Movement to create **The Climate Ticket toolkit** —an election hub filled with resources like easy-to-share posts and talking points that have been tested in the real world with real people.

[**Get access to the toolkit today to arm yourself with messages that are proven to persuade people to say they'll vote for Harris-Walz.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2906036/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[DOWNLOAD AND SHARE OUR TOOLKIT](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2906037/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **Conversations matter, friend.** Their impact goes beyond any text message or email a person will receive about this election. Whether you're out canvassing neighbors or just having coffee with a good friend, talking face-to-face with voters is the most effective way to cut through the noise, create meaningful connections, and make a real difference in what will be the most consequential election of our lifetimes.

So the next time you have a conversation about the election, make sure you're prepared. [**You can find brief talking points and more in our handy toolkit.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2906038/87SdQ4wZ)

In solidarity, |

| Peter,

Once again, the lies of the opposition and Keep It Local ND are being exposed...

They have tried every tactic in the book – _**fear-mongering, misinformation, and outright deception**_ – to stop Measure 4.

But thanks to a new memo released last week by the state legislature's legal team, we can finally put their biggest lies to rest.
---
[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=4fccb9567e&e=d842fb25cc)

---
| **Measure 4 WILL NOT affect the vital gross production and extraction taxes on oil, nor will it touch the coal severance and coal conversion taxes.**

The state’s legal experts confirmed it clearly: these essential revenues will continue flowing, ensuring that our local governments have the funds they need without burdening property owners.

The scare tactics used by opponents were just that — scare tactics.

Even better news — **Measure 4 WILL eliminate taxes on mobile homes**.

Contrary to the false claims spread by the opposition, mobile homeowners will receive the same property tax relief as all North Dakotans. This is a major win for working families and retirees who call these communities home.

We know what’s at stake. Measure 4 is an incredible opportunity to provide real relief to North Dakota property owners, but the opposition won’t back down. They are pouring money into a campaign of fear, and we need your help to fight back.
**JOIN OUR FIGHT TO END NORTH DAKOTA’S UNFAIR PROPERTY TAX BY SELECTING AN OPTION BELOW TODAY!

Every dollar you contribute will go towards combating the lies and making sure voters know the real benefits of Measure 4.

With Election Day fast approaching, we need to push harder than ever to get Measure 4 over the finish line.

Together, we can make history and finally put an end to the state’s unfair property tax. Let’s make sure that every North Dakotan hears the truth before they cast their vote.

Ted Lieu asked on Friday.
My parents asked on Saturday.
I asked you yesterday.

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4us1q1qr93ah71jpo8jsjg9lhaefl3ikrndjkr0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cth60p32cth2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1mm52o4efjcn59cvpg6tdkgormkbu167eudjfkg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cth60p32cth2bs)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zue2tr1bhvill8p58u32i3f8virqs0i73e8qge0g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cth60p32cth2bs)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5d6d1bh41daej35m6akr5v3vjfikc6k64117u3g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cth60p32cth2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

We can’t lose focus | | | Friend, I spoke at an incredible rally with Kamala Harris on Sunday, and I have to tell you: I’m _blown away.

_ [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtHtWNDtXR0WReOmqZcCOXOBAdQ00lrGYxdGkQ7B7WYVoF6jkefCh35zZ8zwCGGe1kdutCKV3jqPRpuK4y57zGUosgezsPW6o6qXIhdT3Mk-d7Ff7-7cHYeChKVFjbChq1ckSRi1Zz9T6KTYYl01i76KlxqUcGDFUAhYjIgeWrKLEt0GZBOzP34l8BRrtOrsiQLLw_oGaSAp6ENqrW6HR_olM5hjs631_PWVnapP6PMM4JY_QKK6z1-LJuHVjYHl6h3jKVNNm-bMLpsUrtNh02ekdyCHtJZZj7yQjg-BogNjk6DX4wyXlc2xo_8jJCBHgATAJpOALQ3z0yARFDeTAddgcjPVavxxEZQFCai6fZnvJ8f-U1XQeNMGbdjlBqZ6HagJKMI8XWyuVqGKa1dqkKwcGE6Os9FneeyQjbvrsWiqYBse29QK5MoiziiXbaWw78/4a7/nkOecdoFQLaxDWVvJqpOag/h0/h001.U7XHJjYrD9aPYnrTuFBqBGlgU0NL17AijIMI9IDi3BE)
It was thrilling to see so many Democrats fired up about defending this battleground – which is key to keeping both the Senate and White House blue. But team, we need to remember: Winning in Nevada this November is not going to be easy.
This state is a toss-up, we’re being called the “most perilous” battleground for Democrats, and right-wing Super PACs are flooding Nevada with millions of dollars to buy my seat and flip it red.

clean_body: We can’t lose focus | | | Friend, I spoke at an incredible rally with Kamala Harris on Sunday, and I have to tell you: I’m blown away. It was thrilling to see so many Democrats fired up about defending this battleground – which is key to keeping both the Senate and White House blue. But team, we need to remember: Winning in Nevada this November is not going to be easy. This state is a toss-up, we’re being called the “most perilous” battleground for Democrats, and right-wing Super PACs are flooding Nevada with millions of dollars to buy my seat and flip it red. The ONLY way we can fight back and win is with the grassroots support of folks like you. | Thank you. 💜 – Jacky Rosen elects Democrats with disabilities. subject: Can you help?
body:
we are falling short of our goal and need your help! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=c29b7a58a1)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Midnight tonight. The final, end-of-quarter fundraising deadline for the FEC is TONIGHT AT MIGNIGHT.

I have to ask for help. We are falling short of our fundraising goals right now by $36,291. Could you send an online donation today?

This is the first deadline since independent polling showed I have a two-point lead over April Delaney, and the first since Fox News declared our race as one of the 5 races in the country that could determine control of the House.

My opponent worked in Biden's Commerce Department - the same department that counted illegal immigrants in the 2020 Census! I really need your help now to make sure that we defeat her and work to bring practical, common-sense solutions to DC.
---
| [DONATE TO MY CAMPAIGN BEFORE MIDNIGHT](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=304fc3c4a3&e=5a45ee1154 "DONATE TO MY CAMPAIGN BEFORE MIDNIGHT")
---
| To help reach this important financial goal, we are having a fundra[](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=4d1392e80f&e=5a45ee1154)iser tonight at the Gaithersburg Mission BBQ. I would love to see you there tonight. If you are able to come or for more information, please click the link below.

Either way, could you please help with a donation right away. We are short of our fundraising deadline by $36,291, and your donation will help us meet the goal and get our commercials out.
---
| [MISSION BBQ FUNDRAISER TONIGHT - DEADLINE TODAY](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=6c79cf3b17&e=5a45ee1154 "MISSION BBQ FUNDRAISER TONIGHT - DEADLINE TODAY")
---
