---
| If we don't raise the money we need to meet our goals, we are opening ourselves up to more attacks from radical-left Democrats at the worst possible time - just a month before the election.

The left-wing mainstream media in Maryland, DC, and all over the country would like nothing more than to report we didn't meet our fundraising goals.

They'd love to write stories saying the Parrott campaign doesn't have what it takes to defeat the big-money and left-wing special interest groups funding April Delaney's campaign.

But we do. We have a great ground game. We have motivated, sincere volunteers. Our message resonates with voters who know that our country needs to fix our problems. But we also need to show enough financial support in this reporting period.

We just need $36,291 today to prove it. If every person reading this sent in just $25, we would reach our goal. Could you could send more than $25? Please, whatever you can send, PLEASE HELP RIGHT AWAY!
---
| [SEND ANY AMOUNT TO MAKE OUR GOAL!](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=d0bd37bbe5&e=5a45ee1154 "SEND ANY AMOUNT TO MAKE OUR GOAL!")
---
|
---
| | I'm counting on my most loyal supporters - those who truly love our country and who know that we need to fix our country's problems rather than bicker over political nonsense - to step up and make a donation to my campaign today.

Any amount will help, and our deadline is MIDNIGHT TONIGHT.

**Your generous donation will put me in a position to win. I appreciate your support and thank you for any amount you can swing today. WHATEVER YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE WILL MAKE A DIFFERENCE!**

For our country,
Neil Parrott

subject: Just 13 days left—here’s how you can help us win!
body:
Ballots are mailed on October 15th—check your registration, join our phonebank, and mark your calendar for the big debate! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6a0dfa915fe6/just-13-days-leftheres-how-you-can-help-us-win?e=830e7edf7b)
---
|
---
[](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=5ef2343233&e=830e7edf7b)
|
---
| Dear ,
We are officially in the home stretch! With **ballots being mailed out on October 15th** , we have only **13 days** left to reach as many voters as possible. Every day counts, and your involvement in the next few weeks will determine the outcome of this election.
Make sure you’re ready by checking your voter registration at [vote.utah.gov](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=c5bb1fd210&e=830e7edf7b). You don’t want to be waiting for a ballot that never arrives, and the **last day to request a mail-in ballot is 5 p.m. on October 29th, 2024**. Don’t miss your chance to have your voice heard!
Now, let me update you on a few critical events and opportunities to help us bring real change to Utah’s 4th District.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
### Phone Banking: The Key to Victory
Phone Banking is CRITICAL for getting out the vote. Reaching voters directly by phone is the BEST way to let them know about me and the issues we’re fighting for. If we can reach enough voters, we will win this election! I encourage you to join one of our upcoming phone banking sessions—we need all hands on deck! Together, we can make sure every voter knows who I am and what we stand for.
---
[Sign Up Now](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=8b452f98bd&e=830e7edf7b)
| | | | | | | | | | |
### KUTV 2 Interview with Heidi Hatch
I recently had the pleasure of sitting down with KUTV 2’s Heidi Hatch for an interview. We covered a lot of important topics, and I’d love for you to watch! You can check it out here: [**YouTube.com**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=8a43f4aa01&e=830e7edf7b)
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=88410484d6&e=830e7edf7b)
---
|
### Join Us at the "We Have the Power" Rally
Mark your calendar for the **We Have the Power Rally** on **October 12th, 2024** at **12 PM** at the **Utah State Capitol - South Steps**. This rally will keep reproductive rights front and center as we approach Election Day. You’ll hear from local voices, including me, as we talk about preserving our rights to reproductive care and the POWER we hold as voters in Utah. Don’t miss this!
---
[Learn more](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=c2e9c6f86c&e=830e7edf7b)
| | | | | | | | | | |
### Debate with Burgess Owens
This is BIG news! On **October 24th at 6 PM,** I’ll be participating in the Utah Debate Commission’s debate for Utah’s 4th Congressional District at the University of Utah, alongside Republican incumbent Burgess Owens. This is a critical moment in our campaign, and I want YOU to be a part of it! It will be broadcast live, and I’ll need your support more than ever—invite your friends, tune in, and spread the word.
---
| Together, we have the power to flip this district and bring real representation back to Utah families. Your support means the world to me, and I’m grateful for everything you’ve done so far. Let’s make these next few weeks count!
---

**Katrina Fallick-Wang** _Candidate for Congress, Utah’s 4th District_

name: Voter Action Project Louisiana
subject: *Eleven* voter suppression bills
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=093024_1&amount=25]
Democracy Docket: Louisiana Governor Signs Multiple Anti-Voter Bills and More Are Pending [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=093024_1&amount=25]
Louisiana's governor, Jeff Landry, has now signed eleven anti-voter bills into law so far this year. He started off with these seven new suppressive laws:
➜ House Bill 285 requires the state secretary of state’s office to create an election integrity division to perform many duties, including “ conducting independent investigations into allegations of election irregularities .”
➜ House Bill 476 restricts people from delivering more than one absentee ballot via mail unless they are sending ballots on behalf of immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 155 only allows individuals to assist with more than one absentee ballot if they are helping immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 218 requires someone assisting a voter to provide their address and relationship to the voter and reveal if they were paid to assist.
➜ Senate Bill 226 requires that an absentee ballot that is missing information and is not fixed by the voter is considered a challenged ballot that is only counted if the majority of the election board decides it should be.
➜ Senate Bill 449 defines a qualified voter or elector as “ a person who has the proper qualifications provided by law to be entitled to vote and who is lawfully registered to vote .”
➜ Senate Bill 101 bans ranked-choice voting in Louisiana elections.
Every single one of these bills was passed with an eye on adding barriers to voting, reducing ballot access, and suppressing participation in Louisiana's elections. Opponents of voting rights are trying to codify their pathway to power in state law instead of winning elections fair and square.

Yadira’s story is a lot like many of ours. She’s the daughter of hard working parents who did everything to build a better life for their children. There are many reasons why I am counting on you to be a part of this moment, but it comes down to this: **This election is so much bigger than me. For New Mexico,

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. clean_body: [ ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE Hi Peter — To be honest, asking for donations is my least favorite part of the job. But the truth is it’s absolutely necessary if we’re going to keep Wisconsin blue and defend this seat. Wisconsin is THE tipping point state. This November, voters in our state will determine which party controls the Senate and the White House. Donald Trump knows this, which is why he’s making back-to-back stops in Wisconsin this week to rally his right-wing base. My opponent knows it too, which is why he’s pledged to spend at least $20 million of his personal fortune to defeat me and flip the one seat Republicans need to control the Senate majority. Republicans have already spent $50 million on ads attacking me and uplifting my opponent. The bad news is, their strategy seems to be working — four recent polls reveal this race is now statistically tied. The good news is we can break this tie and defend our Senate majority if we have the resources necessary to reach voters with our winning message. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eef94b95-967b-4cf1-a33f-443c48a9ddde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Before we get into the very active basins, I want to share a bit about my family's experience with Helene, and the political toxicity that leads to disasters like what is unfolding in Tennessee and North Carolina.
## **Hurricane Helene**
While forecasters will continue to debate whether Helene was a Category 3 or 4 storm at landfall, the real impacts are being felt hundreds of miles from the Florida coast.
Large swaths of Tennessee and North Carolina remain underwater today, nearly four days after the storm's landfall in Florida's Big Bend.
Helene maintained tropical depression strength as it looped over Kentucky this weekend, exacerbating the already life-threatening deluge.
My sister moved from Maine to Greeneville, Tennessee earlier this year. She lives downriver form the [Nolichucky Dam](https://substack.com/redirect/afff32c1-b985-464b-8af0-eb1e4960b918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - a 110-year-old structure [not built to withstand hurricane winds and rain](https://substack.com/redirect/afff32c1-b985-464b-8af0-eb1e4960b918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The aging dam hasn't even been inspected since 2020, even though it's scheduled for inspection every two years, and the results of the inspection don't state the condition of the damn at the time of inspection.

The Evangelicals for Harris Team

Peter,
Tomorrow is the first day of October, and the beginning of the last full month before the 2024 election.
October will be critical for our state newsrooms, Peter. Our reporters will be working around the clock to publish the fearless, factual coverage COURIER is known for.
Unfortunately, it’s the last day of the month, and we’re $6,000 away from our $40,000 September fundraising goal.
**Our deadline is at midnight tonight, so we’re reaching out to ask you to participate in our Sponsor A 2024 Battleground Newsroom Project:**
**You’ve been chosen to sponsor our local news teams! Your donation will support our newsrooms across 11 battleground states — including Arizona, Florida, Iowa, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, New Hampshire, and Wisconsin.**
**Can we count on you to chip in $25 now and help our newsrooms spread their stories across their states?** **[Chip in $25 ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93915929/502048960/1184252563?refcode=20240930-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWVkZjE0MGMtNDU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_IFbWf80b-uYHGJp9CKpdVrPluXnzb5D9ASs-B1TpnU=)**
---
**We’re at a critical turning point in the fight against misinformation, Peter.** Trustworthy local news sources are rapidly disappearing. Media companies are laying off reporters at historic rates. As a result, many communities are relying more and more on right-wing propaganda and social media to get their news.
**COURIER is on the frontlines of protecting access to high quality local news that makes an impact.**
As we enter the final push to election day, we need to be prepared for anything: Trump’s conspiracies, social media misinformation, and the legacy media’s continued bias.
That’s why we set a $40,000 fundraising goal for September – that would make it our biggest fundraising month yet. We need the resources to cover any and everything that comes our way.
**[We have until midnight tonight. Any donation gets us closer to our goal. Can you chip in $25 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93915933/502048963/1184252563?refcode=20240930-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWVkZjE0MGMtNDU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_IFbWf80b-uYHGJp9CKpdVrPluXnzb5D9ASs-B1TpnU=)**

Thank you,
COURIER

Hello,
The system is rigged. We all know it. The only people who can afford to run for Senate full-time are millionaires like my opponent, Republican Deb Fischer.
That’s why they’re the only people who ever win. It’s why the Senate is just another country club full of Ivy League graduates, former business execs, and trust fund babies.
Working people like me, we can’t afford to give up our jobs to run for office. During this campaign, I’ve been working 40, 60, sometimes 90 hours a week as a steamfitter just to pay our bills and put food on the table. How’s anybody with a real job supposed to campaign and win when your opponent is wealthy enough to not work at all?
**That’s why I announced that I am taking a leave from my job as a steamfitter to campaign full-time for the U.S. Senate and keep up our momentum.**
And yes, that means I’m going to need to take a salary from our campaign. Not a big one. Just enough to replace the $48,000 I got paid last year and the cost of health care for me and my family.
Politics shouldn’t only be for the rich, and this is the only way we can change that.

But she still has $2.3 million more than us because of her corporate PAC friends.

Patriot,

**I want to start off saying how extremely grateful I am for your support so far.** This is the race of a lifetime, and what happens in November will determine so much of the future of our country.

That being said, it's almost the end of September, which marks the end of the third Federal Election Commission's Fundraising Quarter. Every quarter, the FEC requires candidates to report their fundraising success and makes their numbers PUBLIC. This is the last FEC Quarter before November 5th, so we need to make sure our numbers are impressive. | [**RUSH $5 TO MY EOQ GOAL >>>**](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=853f35a0b7254ed393c99d37bb71d40c&_e=Jp8VfkHyWCkjYl7Pmt5feOanZ_jnuczaB5oxF_Hl5YGQjkg5ErXhreeFF8rNPn-fUv47Llknct_wWrwQTSjXQFAR1X-_PMBpjoTCZ3a8UTTJraEQSt7pNBY4XoJSqBsc1NhVJWHVzN7T5ZNvfqNk0m0HlXKNRHNEQwd7mHMKYukaTylmWzBLYzZh8KOEBEMfbzN1n4yjJCP3LdYXbo4T7cH1TCCfNXD49EHGxBlB8Z-6ncpFq9044DWeEdEAl2a0GdFNiju6yj0zmUc_xy0cR1HJStqTcvpvS34Nh9Gk7iuRfHoCzZ43N7CCIUrq_Hq4UpnbtH1RUudAljoVYo3aMA%3D%3D)

Key Conservative Donors will review our FEC report and decide if our race is worth investing in; these last-minute dollars are absolutely critical to our mission and can support TV ads, Radio ads, Digital ads, Voter Contact Efforts, and more.

Every single donation, large or small, makes a difference in the outcome of our campaign. Team Harrigan is working day and night to deliver our America-First message before folks cast their votes on Election Day.

We all know that putting the American People First is NOT on the top of the Democrats' to-do list. We see it in our day to day lives; grocery and gas prices are through the roof, mortgage rates are climbing higher and higher, and public safety across the country is at an all time low.

Friend, Tonight at midnight we’ll close the books on the last end-of-quarter fundraising report of the campaign. **What we raise between now and midnight is critical to showing the power of our campaign and our anti-genocide movement.** Billionaires have already spent unprecedented sums in an attempt to influence this election, including defeating two pro-ceasefire members of Congress in their Democratic primaries―Reps. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c315e87b691746f391396576ce852552&_e=zqXd0IWSJMtrMixb3nPKxH-TrYFoMOJESt95WGfDUXEimmdcMrHkKZ_Bf4C6EYaFcMTIyuHdMK87Hb92FRoBnMqLlKySYyOhOWgfSXsN2sxoY3Bko5OaYfF8SkkkUffMX8nHFP42K51IvCCKYR2hLw9gHYruzESmQeay-Pbn9DuC0JTDsIPJvuO9fENemkkGo18DwQiabFjirme0q-KRkP-GNeem84jeEOMUGJUp5JSSS6VRob1Zq-4To_2BpCZVqxTXjCkqqBg9U_mW10-89aXLfBw4LLvTOAIL19vz4OWt4rVHw992L6j7zNvl2hwMo9QrleWBeDcpmqHqDEU_y2jyIuheuZSw4BmClaiB2xFKBMw5ND35av99v2m_PDdcijgBy0UUfP5C3PWC55Aqit6pxov1zZnr51GwivOQbXs%3D) Dear Fellow American, Thanks for opening my email. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c315e87b691746f391396576ce852552&_e=zqXd0IWSJMtrMixb3nPKxH-TrYFoMOJESt95WGfDUXEimmdcMrHkKZ_Bf4C6EYaFcMTIyuHdMK87Hb92FRoBnMqLlKySYyOhOWgfSXsN2sxoY3Bko5OaYfF8SkkkUffMX8nHFP42K51IvCCKYR2hLw9gHYruzESmQeay-Pbn9DuC0JTDsIPJvuO9fENemkkGo18DwQiabFjirme0q-KRkP-GNeem84jeEOMUGJUp5JSSS6VRob1Zq-4To_2BpCZVqxTXjCkqqBg9U_mW10-89bi_G58JfHRY1gLuMningStyh-X1NPcPN9ZianPmET4czYEVk-pGUWMONZtNIftHBppJKNibBZstYPdiFp8Yqzg_aOQYUKEKCNn8QA3YpK5_ygF6_M0Ucw-4plJFdEo7mAiGtD_M4r8n57isA_Umgoc%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. For New Mexico,

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Everyone Become a Socialist?"

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

A few
years ago, New York magazine posed the question: "When Did
Everyone Become a Socialist?"

This is,
of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left
in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and
our way of life.

In a
recent issue of Imprimis-Hillsdale College's digest of
liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of
the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a
two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on
top and socialism for the majority below."

Today, as
a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand
the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism.

Your
input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight
for the future of liberty in our country.

Will you
please share your views on the political, social, and cultural
forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your
National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63594149:WA-T3cW3N:m:3:2532013465:79DCD7BB5CB86A3B907A238B8B2D8982:r

Do you
believe politicians who encourage young people to embrace
socialism are doing a disservice to the country?
YES
NO

Sadly,
socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the
young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that...

. . .
during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those
16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also
increased in popularity among all ages.

Why is
this?

Draconian
government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated
competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream
come true for corporate socialists.

At the
same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what
socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures
wherever it has been tried.

This is a
result of the far-Left's "long march through the
institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools,
and the media.

Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once
confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race
theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as
school boards and even the military.

But it is
in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which
teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens
according to race-are most dangerous.

You may
recall that many young Americans with college degrees who
championed socialist policies participated in the riots and
violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020.

In the
face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free
markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to reach and
teach millions has never been more urgently needed.

That's
why I need your thoughts quickly.

By
responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five
days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent
rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach
increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

We hope
to hear from friends representing every part of the country.

Education
is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your
partnership with Hillsdale College is critical.

As
Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure,
the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy."

If you
agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey
on Socialism today.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63594149:WA-T3cW3N:m:3:2532013465:79DCD7BB5CB86A3B907A238B8B2D8982:r

Despite
the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-it is
NEVER too late to defend liberty through education.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of Imprimis-Hillsdale College's digest of liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below? Do you believe politicians who encourage young people to embrace socialism are doing a disservice to the country? YES NO Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... . . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. Why is this? Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race-are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to reach and teach millions has never been more urgently needed. That's why I need your thoughts quickly. By responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education. Warm regards, Larry P. body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
I want to thank everyone who has contributed this year, this quarter, this month, and this week ahead of tonight’s FEC deadline [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240930?refcode=lpfe240930] —and ahead of Election Day, which is now just over one month away.
We know the stakes for this election could not be higher.
From the White House to the House of Representatives, we need to elect people who will represent us and lead us as we deserve—responsibly and with integrity. #TeamLizzie will keep working every day until November 5 to make sure we elect the leaders we need in places we need them—by winning our race here in #TX07 and by supporting other candidates on the ballot, like Colin Allred and Vice President Harris.
We know what it takes to win.
Our campaign has invested millions of dollars over the years in reaching and engaging voters, in increasing voter turnout, and in shaping a path forward for our community and country. We helped change the direction of the country by winning back the House majority in 2018 and holding on to it in 2020. We helped make possible the great work of the Biden-Harris Administration and put a check on the worst impulses of the Trump Administration.
We know we need you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240930?refcode=lpfe240930]
After years of running and winning tough races, I know contributions of all kinds matter—from sending a postcard or making a phone call to sending in a financial contribution. All of these efforts are essential to winning—and hitting our goal of reaching 25,000 new voters.
Your response to these deadlines and your generous contributions are so meaningful. As we reach the last quarterly deadline of this election cycle, I hope you will consider making a financial contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240930?refcode=lpfe240930] (And tomorrow, we will send you a whole bunch of ways to contribute your time.)
Thank you for all you have done and will do. Together, we are going to win this election.
Together, we can do anything,
LizzieSignature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

Friend,
I wanted to make sure you saw the email that Jerry sent to you yesterday. We are working hard to make certain we leave no stone unturned to raise an additional [$23,830](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ppiY697QuOOtvpPMRKE7HF4cyx5H4WNMPUIMaBEe-V_aUAaw9nYg_RHlq79mqgFcvJA-DkT8Pf6Z8xMuyx9FMY9TkboP-68Qr6tLwPcHJbtW-mrnwxOfsjtpFS93beVbDKP1hpC_ABgbt9o6SveguCXrKEnusJuqdPoTVDsHSYz5G_kOqO3QI4hXSl9IZL_Qetq36Rc0H8U=&c=QJ0_h2qKkDUO63m95qBAg-m8AAp2C835nT7sNbV9z1Uh8CKpS631BQ==&ch=w3-mTnpV2aovucRdSdxW1xzARvu_YBY8bx3hqHI-Re2bm5bMw168Ow==) before the September 30th fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.
As Jerry's Campaign Manager, I have seen up close what a great candidate Jerry is and how hard he will work for the Illinois 11th Congressional District. It's such a shame that for nearly 15 years, our district has had virtually no leadership or even representation of any kind with Bill Foster.
Jerry wants that to change - and change now!
But it takes money to win and my ask to you is that you help us by contributing to our campaign. The maximum an individual can give is $3,300 per person/$6,600 per couple. To donate, you can [Click Here](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ppiY697QuOOtvpPMRKE7HF4cyx5H4WNMPUIMaBEe-V_aUAaw9nYg_RHlq79mqgFcvJA-DkT8Pf6Z8xMuyx9FMY9TkboP-68Qr6tLwPcHJbtW-mrnwxOfsjtpFS93beVbDKP1hpC_ABgbt9o6SveguCXrKEnusJuqdPoTVDsHSYz5G_kOqO3QI4hXSl9IZL_Qetq36Rc0H8U=&c=QJ0_h2qKkDUO63m95qBAg-m8AAp2C835nT7sNbV9z1Uh8CKpS631BQ==&ch=w3-mTnpV2aovucRdSdxW1xzARvu_YBY8bx3hqHI-Re2bm5bMw168Ow==) to help Jerry's campaign.
Please take a minute to read the email Jerry sent yesterday (it's pasted below) and it is my hope that you will help us by [donating before midnight tonight](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ppiY697QuOOtvpPMRKE7HF4cyx5H4WNMPUIMaBEe-V_aUAaw9nYg_RHlq79mqgFcvJA-DkT8Pf6Z8xMuyx9FMY9TkboP-68Qr6tLwPcHJbtW-mrnwxOfsjtpFS93beVbDKP1hpC_ABgbt9o6SveguCXrKEnusJuqdPoTVDsHSYz5G_kOqO3QI4hXSl9IZL_Qetq36Rc0H8U=&c=QJ0_h2qKkDUO63m95qBAg-m8AAp2C835nT7sNbV9z1Uh8CKpS631BQ==&ch=w3-mTnpV2aovucRdSdxW1xzARvu_YBY8bx3hqHI-Re2bm5bMw168Ow==). Jerry can win but we need your help to make that happen!
I thank you in advance for your consideration.
On to Victory, Mary Buell Campaign Manager Jerry Evans for Congress

| Here's Jerry's email from yesterday:

Friend,
The issues couldn't be more clear - the constituents in Illinois' 11th Congressional District are worried. Seriously worried about how they are going to pay their bills each month.
Questions are being asked around the kitchen table late at night - "do we pay the car insurance this month or our health insurance premiums?"
"What if our prescription drug copay continues to rise - do we pay for some of the drugs we need and not others?"
"What if heating oil prices continue to rise and how do we pay to heat our home this winter?"
"Should we only go to the grocery store once every three weeks instead of weekly when prices continue to rise on daily essentials like butter, milk & eggs?"
These are all questions that are keeping the voters in our district up at night - both figuratively and literally.
THIS is why I am running for Congress, because I share the same worries. I know every politician says they know what it's like to pay a mortgage and run a business. But I actually do know what it's like to pay the mortgage every month and run a business to support my family. We have the same worries as you, and my opponent, Bill Foster, is now talking about raising taxes! He has had almost 15 years to step up and has done nothing for the 11th Congressional District.
I want to be your Congressman to get things done. I also know that I have the ability to reach across the aisle to work with Republicans and Democrats so that we can make our community a model.
[But you know to get elected I need your support.](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ppiY697QuOOtvpPMRKE7HF4cyx5H4WNMPUIMaBEe-V_aUAaw9nYg_RHlq79mqgFcvJA-DkT8Pf6Z8xMuyx9FMY9TkboP-68Qr6tLwPcHJbtW-mrnwxOfsjtpFS93beVbDKP1hpC_ABgbt9o6SveguCXrKEnusJuqdPoTVDsHSYz5G_kOqO3QI4hXSl9IZL_Qetq36Rc0H8U=&c=QJ0_h2qKkDUO63m95qBAg-m8AAp2C835nT7sNbV9z1Uh8CKpS631BQ==&ch=w3-mTnpV2aovucRdSdxW1xzARvu_YBY8bx3hqHI-Re2bm5bMw168Ow==) Many of you have donated to my campaign, knocked doors, made phone calls and have come out to our events, and I thank you. But we have a critical fundraising deadline at midnight on September 30th and I need your help to make sure that all the voters get to see my message of hope and opportunity.
The maximum you can donate to my campaign is $3,300 per person/$6,660 per couple. If you have not maxed out, I would humbly ask for your generous financial support and help us before the September 30th deadline. If you have given, it would mean so much to me to have you match the donation you previously gave to the campaign.
Contributions can be made at [www.jerryevansforcongress.com/donate](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ppiY697QuOOtvpPMRKE7HF4cyx5H4WNMPUIMaBEe-V_aUAaw9nYg_RHlq79mqgFcvJA-DkT8Pf6Z8xMuyx9FMY9TkboP-68Qr6tLwPcHJbtW-mrnwxOfsjtpFS93beVbDKP1hpC_ABgbt9o6SveguCXrKEnusJuqdPoTVDsHSYz5G_kOqO3QI4hXSl9IZL_Qetq36Rc0H8U=&c=QJ0_h2qKkDUO63m95qBAg-m8AAp2C835nT7sNbV9z1Uh8CKpS631BQ==&ch=w3-mTnpV2aovucRdSdxW1xzARvu_YBY8bx3hqHI-Re2bm5bMw168Ow==). It will take you right to the donation page.
I know I can win. And when I do win, I will work every day for YOU.
I thank you in advance for your consideration and your help.
Sincerely,
Jerry Evans
P.S. One last thing -it would be so helpful if you would be willing to forward this email to 3 friends so that they can help too. Thank You!

** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fcbdf289ae374155a5305bb1dd626a4d&_e=bguB9vZHYyPtAjEtKgbX2UHvW1vSNY0r9DPVRqeLLhJFPoCgzm28tWGlq-cIgNjI0ooBeN7QWd7yJ30NgqhfW2fKUgyEb59ISLQeYsm70DMFkJfhYnoBCycmY-xvrj7e8kKg862QgNJE1gRc66ptrhg7yBqUE3Ec7b7ObAj67nijRWeX9GVUgpgl5VrKbHSG2AfUN9Zecf-vnOqViYsivGaebXrAF6VY7YBhexu-FssJw1iOBHkvIlngTzefE2kBMFBuJEZdHO-zL6NPKrCgRxaa-j7gZ-liNL33WhdLh4XthRqlZW-AMSDaol3dXHKFRsJV19AFz8gvmA1E-IC2oqvz8aRlXkokZ0QSIPC25c8S2phXcORKSl-qWVCg8iAkpn7lR26w-K2r0jiAi-TzYzY7fKiO1AQK7cH7QaknRDU%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

I listen. We do!” because I firmly believe that the first step in being an effective leader and representative for others starts with listening.

There’s so much we’ve accomplished together during this campaign, and there’s so much that I’m ready to do in Congress. But, we need your help to get there.

We've had a busy year at the 1776 Project PAC. So far, the 1776 Project has been involved in around 60 school board races through the spring and summer, from Tennessee to Wisconsin. This November, we have 37 additional races, and five runoffs or general elections from previous months.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..h5rGYzS_Pn7i7WnegdLpb72ojnrOCClQeJCMcXuY4MA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149613204)
**OUR ROLE IN WISCONSIN**
The total amount spent on school board elections in Wisconsin has **skyrocketed** in the last decade. But do you noticed where the biggest increase is?
The **Democratic Party.**
The local GOPs in Wisconsin were badly outraised in the spring races, but luckily independent groups like ours were able to pick up the slack. The Democratic Party in particular has been increasing their direct involvement in school board races. They aren't just leaving the job to teacher's unions anymore -- the fight to control our kids' education is a losing battle for them, and now they have to redouble their investments.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/88d62ff1-7595-4645-bead-5ab81c47e865?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In fact, the 1776 Project was the **single biggest supporter** of school board candidates in Wisconsin for the spring election cycle. The 1776 Project outraised and outspent every other independent group combined -- liberal and conservative.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b802eeb-d2bc-4cba-b525-40b8cd9f8935?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: Political parties and PACs influence school board seats, over $348,000 spent - The Daily Cardinal
The result of that spending is clear. The 1776 Project won nearly 60% of our races in Wisconsin despite the large gap in funding -- a testament to the grassroots desire to make school boards more responsive and transparent in their communities.
**TEXAS BEARS FRUIT**
In May, Southlake-Carroll ISD **sued** the Biden Administration over their proposed Title IX changes. In July, a federal judge granted them a temporary ruling **in favor** of the suit, halting any proposed Title IX implementation for the school district (and eventually across the state).
Southlake is one of the first boards where the 1776 Project PAC has helped support 100% of the Board of Trustees. They're doing an incredible job!
**OUR PLAN FOR NOVEMBER**
The 1776 Project recently released our November endorsements, focused on Arizona and Maryland.
In Maryland, we have the opportunity to flip a handful of boards or strengthen the conservative majority on others.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0375dfa-1921-4c61-8262-cf9578c1103b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our races in Arizona reflect opportunities to flip boards that have been neglected since the pandemic -- and hopefully drive conservative voters to make informed decisions, since the Arizona ballot will be **two pages long**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e4cdc57-9a7c-47ec-9129-b405007fb323?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our efforts this year are pivotal to keep the momentum alive. The DNC, teachers unions, and independent progressive groups are all realigning their budgets to focus on local board races -- where they've already dominated for decades before the post-Covid parental movement.
The 1776 Project is an existential threat to their agenda.
We're here to empower parents, not elect stooges for unelected administrators.
We're here to turn our public education system around.
We we're here to make sure our kids can read and do math.
We're here to make sure schools are transparent actors in the community.
And with your help, we'll get the job done this year, and in the years to come.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd44ddb-ec4e-4033-8df5-aef45a37541d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| Our Attorney General stands as Oregon’s last line of defense against national attacks against our abortion rights. With the looming threat of a nationwide abortion ban, protecting access to abortion is on the ballot right here in Oregon.

**There is only one candidate we can trust to uphold Oregon’s pro-choice laws and values: Dan Rayfield.

Join me in supporting Dan with a contribution today to make sure that our next Attorney General will never back down on abortion rights. **

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to split a donation between four California Democrats running to flip Republican House seats — seats we need to win to take the House majority in November.
I am sure your inbox is filled with a lot of fundraising requests right now, but please give me a chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so important.

If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6d7f6dbf1985429594078330e6a777e6&_e=bq4p-uQ9NH00BuLEzUQVrWhvmtAwGkK_wGadTDWppOekuwXA5-wW3H2f8Duz9HJ4t3RsfKhyIti_PAE8Do9CAnhbl6NJ7cr3A08OF39pVmLxnHwtULKiLlCE5aZheWrT2KSq8rj79eblORo7Vcz76ZLjZxzH29Z3022YhLkGc12TOYYHPlohMX6-lvsz34oMdnG0DeWL5DmMO-0-N3t3AZPc9bBmy4rHwTi0i4FdqNY%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6d7f6dbf1985429594078330e6a777e6&_e=bq4p-uQ9NH00BuLEzUQVrWhvmtAwGkK_wGadTDWppOekuwXA5-wW3H2f8Duz9HJ4t3RsfKhyIti_PAE8Do9CAubD0mefqO-GK5f5o9dTaeIgbfDuVkY-4FMxO7ssGy87JgttF7I9Tdcqv6AhLX818vjXUiOg3Cf1prihM_Ycl0OR81rWjUy2kG5y98uPEZ1WEvWUT2l9sQwXPSm0qJyN_k0UbM7085WL-9ujnNCpAbU%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

**2024 Senate Candidates**

Here’s the list of Senate candidates we are supporting this year — three incumbents and five challengers. ▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (TX) ▶︎ Sen. Rick Scott (FL)
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (MO)

Partisan election officials conduct these mass registered voter removals, as required by recent Texas voter suppression laws -- laws that include limits on mail-in ballots, drop boxes, laws targeting only Harris County (home to Houston), and so much more.
These purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . It's legalized voter suppression at its worst.

| Many people don’t believe we can oust my extremist opponentjust because he is an incumbent and [our district has been gerrymandered to hell](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=3a42efd132&e=395a33a3d2).

**We’re in a new era in Texas politics, and****I am a different candidate.**

I am not a candidate funded by Super PACs, large corporations, or the national or state party. That’s why I’m relying on your help to get us across the finish line today!
We have only $7,643 left to raise by MIDNIGHT TONIGHT!

**Chip Roy thinks this seat belongs to him,****but it is OURS, and it is time we take it back!**
[**If you are ready to Flip Chip,**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=93f1b1a165&e=395a33a3d2)[**please pitch in $25, $50, or $100 TODAY!**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=19af8aa699&e=395a33a3d2)****

name: Wisconsin Senate Update
subject: Losing this race could cost Democrats control of the Senate majority
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| The polls are tightening in Wisconsin.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=3901%2E35263%2E267GoP)
| Hi Peter — Our last FEC end-of-quarter deadline is at midnight, but **[before we ask you to make a donation](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep24.J2i10d&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20240930_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=3901%2E35263%2E267GoP)** , we want to explain what’s brewing in Wisconsin’s battleground Senate race:
---
Four recent polls show Tammy and her right-wing opponent locked in a statistically tied race, making this one of the most competitive elections in the entire country.
---
As the polls tighten, multiple election experts are taking notice of this neck-and-neck race. **Inside Elections downgraded our race in the GOP’s direction, and RealClearPolitics rated our race as a “Toss Up.”**
---

body:
Hi –
I’m reaching out today because I want you to know how grateful I am for your partnership in this work.
What we’re trying to do – regain a Democratic House majority, send Kamala Harris to the White House, defeat extremists who divide our country – is no easy feat. But every time I connect with this team, whether it’s in person, on the phone, or via email, I am reminded that if we work together, we can get this done.
The stakes are just so high. I remember in 2016, working on Hillary Clinton’s campaign, some people said our fears about a Donald Trump presidency were unfounded. That we were overreacting.
Today, we read story after story in newspapers across the country about women who are dying because of Trump’s abortion bans. We see schools in Springfield, Ohio being evacuated from bomb scares after Trump and Vance spread baseless racist conspiracy theories.
I think we all know now that we can’t afford a second Trump term. But it’s not just voting against him – it’s voting for a strong, joyful leader who believes in the fundamental American values of freedom and equality. It’s electing the first woman, the first Black woman, and first South Asian woman president. It’s bringing Tim Walz’s frankly immaculate vibes along with her.
But we have to put in the work. Election Day is five weeks from tomorrow, and millions of people are already voting, so we don’t have a minute to waste.
Before tonight’s quarterly FEC deadline, will you step up and pitch in what you can? Your donations help me work to win my own re-election *and* support my Democratic allies who are running in really tough races.
You can give online via this link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much. I’m grateful to be doing this work with you!
-Sara

* Against automatic VA health care enrollment.

Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”

Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.

✔ You are an Oregon resident
✔ You will submit an Oregon tax return for 2024

Please accept my apologies for today in advance, Peter

Today is officially the most important day of my campaign to date. _**Not only are we a little more than 12 hours from the single most significant fundraising deadline of the entire 2024 election cycle, but I’m also debating Jon Tester one final time before voters begin receiving their ballots in a little more than a week.**_

**[We’re still $50,000 short of our Q3 fundraising goal](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=df451881e4284a7bb19fa20297886981&_e=LGrvqZgoUJNCcKBTTJaKtsX6oAe0lmOsBcWGxS-3V3Skh_DzIucALHg9cTEeDlK9DK-1GJv37FgEyX2Jjo4ufe5ukGzMJtatkG750O1JkxIgWtrk6apW8qe0MsGSzh39GDGUZDuFLEChlT2THu6iz0m7pEGc1DVShJuj7yFWSxmSB2YIDzOwYbAGVsRCsyzT-BvA8cx7-9vmZk-JWjgGOb73ZqQ0dfpNhgtJ_LJ2tIlIER6iXpzvFbX4U2EaZxMjvlOKkmrK3DxhRrjGoCIdAO1rRKNwpLiuq-oKxqu9VWJKB_Fy3HhGC7ufbcjRxvaPn9ClxPmS8vjDZsa91d-QVjyKfqGI9otqGlWmsYSIMd2GyE8K8LLCm2PQFn79dwBa5NUnD-Cxk-istUlAt2fjM5E6_2BwP1ON_4AG38_X32c%3D)** and running precariously short on time to raise funds before the books close on the quarter tonight at midnight.

We can’t wait any longer - we’re in dire need of your assistance today. **[Can you send $5, $25, or even $50 to help us hit our fundraising goal today?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=df451881e4284a7bb19fa20297886981&_e=LGrvqZgoUJNCcKBTTJaKtsX6oAe0lmOsBcWGxS-3V3Skh_DzIucALHg9cTEeDlK9DK-1GJv37FgEyX2Jjo4ufe5ukGzMJtatkG750O1JkxIgWtrk6apW8qe0MsGSzh39GDGUZDuFLEChlT2THu6iz0m7pEGc1DVShJuj7yFWSxmSB2YIDzOwYbAGVsRCsyzT-BvA8cx7-9vmZk-JWjgGOb73ZqQ0dfpNhgtJ_LJ2tIlIER6iXpzvFbX4U2EaZxMjvlOKkmrK3DxhRrjGoCIdAFxqq2zfdSe0LiZrCLKYjlX5G9EdqFNUMgawb767P8pa97t71U13ATqfz3LUN2yBhppuUWyy9Tk6RCRt5cGA9mi3mewsaAZCF1MPD08_bskk8C5jQdiQsHg4opak-TD26k9wqKHc-1z2rEF5L0xaVuE%3D)**

**Congressman Burchett Suspends Campaign Fundraising, Urges Support for Helene Victims**
---
**KNOXVILLE, Tenn. (Sept. 30, 2024)** – Congressman Tim Burchett is suspending all campaign fundraising activities while parts of East Tennessee recover from the effects of Hurricane Helene, and he is encouraging the community to support the relief effort.“Like everyone across the country, I’ve watched in horror as Hurricane Helene devastated our neighbors in Upper East Tennessee. “As of today, Sept. 30, 2024, I’m suspending all campaign fundraising efforts for two weeks and encouraging all my supporters to donate to or volunteer with disaster relief efforts in East Tennessee and Western North Carolina. I’m donating $2,500 to the [East Tennessee Foundation’s Neighbor to Neighbor Disaster Relief Fund](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e30a0b04a7bc4dfca9be067dbfa156ee&_e=OXtUFLeW_0UOk2o-JSORyb7LpAje8bfcToPxzncgUiw8bG7wR19w_UuqrhZiGuRSAUJBgkV0g5X7SedpYy2rRXSbMsexqsbNh32C63qaiGmfEcHk4KPZ-LC8BUFOKKl3FFFlgtRYYjhwY05A1GgErDyBt1VxyyXSQdlzrTNrRBeIviLiWlHIWhQEu7H8h7mcecUrb8qESH9gbVZECrrJFQopwyFUbomN7cnuVW-H-q46VeaZM5JckLjMXrela6AEnhp4Py3FehBG5lsLWUOyW4D8qMlG_54Neo5ZeOwEtfc%3D) and $2,500 to [Samaritan’s Purse.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e30a0b04a7bc4dfca9be067dbfa156ee&_e=OXtUFLeW_0UOk2o-JSORydT-T59owx0yDIjRYaYwxV5SnuOF3GLKLSYLNd5Cx9RpP-kdjq8r-ijZ2m16PASn8HzV-wa9y6DP9QR5NA5q3T3mxEDnel4w6gj6dbZrcD8mgsKeyZsAu9Zlcm8fawQRk7ycQ2BfCDVz1_OLpGZjoEuEL8LDqsj4y_4Gcgge1gDQlvWtRb-8_tq5igLDhhQmd4OvvJYkuKAKcX7GkTzeXn3Hd777RV_GImvULF8o84p2) I hope you’ll join me in supporting worthy charities providing boots-on-the-ground support to our neighbors in these hard-hit communities. “Folks, this is a pivotal time in any campaign, but right now, it’s not about politics – it’s about people. Every dollar helps, but if you can’t financially support the relief effort, I ask that you join Kelly, Isabel, and me as we pray for those impacted by this devastating storm.” ###

[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240930_mark_robinson_link1]
Our founding fathers must be rolling in their graves over what people like Jim Jordan have done to this country.
The modern-day Republican Party – poisoned by the ULTRA-MAGA movement and their plastic patriotism – isn’t the legacy they built.
Real patriotism doesn’t have anything to do with worshiping Donald Trump.
It’s about respecting everyone’s freedoms, taking care of our neighbors, and creating opportunities so that everyone has the chance to get ahead.
Jim Jordan doesn’t believe in any of that.
We’ve got him cornered in this race and he knows it. This is the most important congressional race in the country because we have a REAL SHOT at tearing down Trump’s biggest bootlicker in Congress.
We have a MASSIVE PUSH to our quarterly fundraising deadline tonight, and people are watching this race to see if we can deliver. Our national movement is so strong that if everyone reading this email right now pitched in $25, $50 or more, we would INSTANTLY DOUBLE our fundraising this month. Will you help me get over the finish line? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240930_patriotism_link]
Jordan wants to decide who gets to be an American. He wants to control our lives and our bodies so that only HE gets to decide what it means to love your country.
NOT ON OUR WATCH. Let’s show Jim Jordan that his plastic patriotism doesn’t represent us.
Together, we’ll build a future where every American has a fair shot and where our leaders respect the values that make this country great.
Working for US,

Abby’s a Penn State student gearing up to vote in her very first presidential election. When we asked why she’s so fired up to make a difference in this race, Abby told us that she wants to protect abortion access and LGBTQ+ rights. She knows that using her voice in a battleground state like Pennsylvania is critical for protecting our rights and democracy. AND SHE’S NOT ALONE! Millions of young voters nationwide are ready and waiting to make their voices heard. name: Becca Balint
subject: Reaching out after Hurricane Helene
body:
Peter, this kind of flooding is historic. I’m sure that for many Vermonters, this news is all too similar to what we have experienced as a state this past summer and even the summer before.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93934466/502101165/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDk4ZjhiMy01ZDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VYCJhTMRa_z2D0EbTfPiL8G2pGp28687k2QAbIbCGJ0=&emci=f697f8b3-5d7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=0098f8b3-5d7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=43402272) | Peter, As we start the week, what’s on my mind is the historic damage done by Hurricane Helene. As you may know, after hitting Florida, she moved across southern Appalachia and caused flooding, destruction, and loss of life this past weekend. My thoughts are with all of those impacted by the hurricane, especially those who have lost friends and family members. I’m also thinking of the many Americans who are still living without running water or power right now. **Peter, this kind of flooding is historic. I’m sure that for many Vermonters, this news is all too similar to what we have experienced as a state this summer and the summer before. ** As the effects of climate change become more severe and spread across the country, I want to reach out and say that I share your concerns. From Vermont to Florida, to North Carolina and Tennessee and beyond, climate change affects all of us. It’s on legislators like me to address these problems, and I’m as committed as ever to taking bold and necessary action to combat climate change and protect all Americans from similar disasters in the future. **Make no mistake: Climate change is real, it is here, and we’re going to tackle it together with urgency and unity.** You have my word that I will prioritize fighting for climate action in Congress. Please visit [_**usa.gov/hurricane-helene**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93934467/502101166/1499287539?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDk4ZjhiMy01ZDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VYCJhTMRa_z2D0EbTfPiL8G2pGp28687k2QAbIbCGJ0=&emci=f697f8b3-5d7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=0098f8b3-5d7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=43402272) for guidance and resources if you have been directly affected by Hurricane Helene. Thank you for reading, and be safe,
Becca

Fellow American,

**There are two things on my mind: Sanity and Logic.[Before I explain why, can you chip in a small donation before midnight to my America-First campaign?](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=712944c08e4b49e0b297cdcc53da3b41&_e=8iLSoWvSfiBtzOpseT5-AVO8BjTdL6TND2L0hmtvqt3GLKF4DrwBi9jSHaPIodn29WheD0IXI8HWBB4YrP2NbzmBIS8MvMHwwAM431Ln1l2SR4NFodZ3mSOfc4BMpLe1DgGWDAisqu9qoOyezTmg6MQ8HSHYo4igypVnuMgRNweBzcDQLv59rOEwO-xNjHX16Mug31D-8bjzxlR78NgOOyiXk4fllRQ1R48oRgC-s6eQOMEZNV1q9rWtU7rYPH8J-wZ_A8kTaY7r7R9pKkL9443ahXnON0FNWju7rbquVtp6aDxmXK-tl0ZjM-PnU-Dt)**

The top is having a basketball in your hands, taking the game-winning shot in front of 14,000 screaming fans. All their energy and hope is on you in that moment and delivering victory under pressure. The top is having four beautiful, healthy, smart children.

The bottom is being addicted to a drug you were legally prescribed (Xanax) as a teenager and not knowing the real dangers at the time. The bottom is being in debt and having people criticize your character because of it.

**But, that’s f***ing America.**

_In many ways, I’m different than you. In others, I’m just like you._

I’m not asking you to trust me to lead because I’m better than you, I’m asking you to trust me because I know you. I know what this system has created and I’m damn lucky to have survived it myself.

I’ve had a lot of close calls as a young Black Man growing up in the neighborhood. But, if I survived it, then **THIS NATION CAN SURVIVE IT!**

_We need real leaders. I’ll dedicate myself to helping this country if you dedicate yourself to seeking the truth no matter how inconvenient and uncomfortable it may be._

**They don’t want you to contribute, but if we want real change,[I need you to donate whatever you can afford.](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=712944c08e4b49e0b297cdcc53da3b41&_e=8iLSoWvSfiBtzOpseT5-AVO8BjTdL6TND2L0hmtvqt3GLKF4DrwBi9jSHaPIodn29WheD0IXI8HWBB4YrP2NbzmBIS8MvMHwwAM431Ln1l2SR4NFodZ3mSOfc4BMpLe1DgGWDAisqu9qoOyezTmg6J7x_Yb0bGaD-VY8Lwy2BNWTxXGf3bzklRafgovnf4RUBlNvCzF4r1cn-74yeNoQaI1fJuC-XQUWUMJrWsYi9_nH_e0HfF098MSmpD8kK00xr6Mp26wo_-f-NPrEmwPdkWDTsMLnS4y0QkZWQBko3HB2Lz3gpSduogK_kzKvLW-G)**

Peter, The choices we make in the closing weeks of this election will determine the kind of future we build for ourselves and our children. Today, I’m asking for your help with a project that’s near and dear to my heart: **putting an end to extreme partisan gerrymandering. ** It seems that Republicans have decided they can’t win on their ideas alone, so they’re trying to manipulate the maps and the rules in order to hold onto power. Every time they succeed, our democracy gets weaker. It’s not just about who gets representation and who doesn’t — it’s about the basic principle that holds the American experiment together: the idea that, in a democracy, _every voice matters._ Unfortunately, this issue just isn’t on the radar for most voters. That’s why it’s so important for the people who get it — and I’m looking at you, Peter — to do everything we can to stop politicians from picking their voters instead of the other way around. [**Will you join me in supporting the NDRC ahead of today’s quarterly deadline? Make a donation today to help elect candidates who will uphold and strengthen our democracy.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93935904/502104648/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_ObamaEOQNOR2_email_20240930-NDRC-Tier1-ObamaEOQNOR2_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240930-NDRC-Tier1-ObamaEOQNOR2_&utm_campaign=ObamaEOQNOR2&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIyNWE1NzRkLTVlN2YtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ih7tJyx-e1sSV_SA3rDRXoE1bSAxlIi9NtuvoYCmYH8=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

I want to be clear about one thing: **A donation is about more than just the money.** It means you have skin in the game. No matter the amount, your contribution is a symbol of your commitment to building a stronger, fairer democracy.
I've been proud to support the NDRC and my friend Eric Holder over the past seven years, and I’ve seen them develop and execute a comprehensive plan to put a stop to Republican gerrymandering. It’s because of that work that Americans are voting in an election with some of the fairest maps of our lifetimes.
**Peter, now I’m asking you to join me — to place your trust in the NDRC and to believe that, together, we can and will protect our democracy.**

name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: A personal ask:
body:
Peter, I wanted to reach out to you personally in one of the most important moments of this campaign.
Hey Peter, it's Yass.
I wanted to reach out to you personally because tonight at midnight we close the books on the final quarter of our campaign.
This is our last opportunity to raise the funds we need for the home stretch of this race. The month before Election Day is our most critical time to educate voters and get out the vote — and it's not just our seat in Congress that's at stake.
**Arizonans will soon head to the polls to decide who controls the White House, the Senate, and the future of reproductive rights in our state.**
Our grassroots GOTV efforts will make the difference in those races, Peter. Whether you've been with us from the beginning or you just joined our team, we need your support now to finish this work.

Fellow Patriot,

I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about how the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania and the great people of my county helped shape who I am today.

_**I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end.**_

Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=96d305f072a24a6693e1daa23780b94a&_e=rLWAmUA0TrXcu7tiB2bGwbozTp5Qh7igD4Lwdd2aZPcyvovK-nlTHzrqfzEfj_tD21zstxkLlfsHorwIKA6-ekLfxhgET5brmkLih8C5fMjmb-AZNopVXao14mClXhgpYrU_LU9VVxYwRLCzLCPsJlVxnm8DDOGpwJbQPgGynWpJZDM1dm6xC23I3Fc_UJ2kTzb7T_psivshTo5Z-eHhZQD-vJb7fDpOeXrQ6dQ14kCVCchjPOigZvXt2KfwDVRPJD-fXRbijyk34vpODp1elVW2p6UnYirL1yk5_EPldPMoWX6cXI9ZdcgA7mIgnVSCXnhIm2TUC6SKlwypWpZXEKmyd105sglB198Kwj9YDkkIq0a3aUlGzhsNWkG2pY1E34dwetKp2j7mAA6OPYBZag%3D%3D)

Peter,

We don’t send emails like this asking for your hard-earned dollars just for the sake of it.

We have only hours left before tonight’s FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, and we have a crucial goal to hit. We need to raise $6,000 by midnight to keep our campaign strong and ready for the final stretch before November.

That means ensuring we’re able to reach voters across our district, printing mailers, hiring dedicated staff, and paying for the crucial office supplies that our team relies on daily.

# **The Continued Fight**
---
| | | | folks, This is the moment. November 5th is a monumental day for America, but the work doesn’t stop there. Once the dust settles from this historic election, the real challenge begins: mobilizing in off-years to secure gains through special elections, ballot initiatives, and preparation for the midterms. The special elections, ballot initiatives, and groundwork for the midterms are where **real, lasting change happens** —and we need to stay mobilized to win it all. If we want to keep building momentum and flipping seats, we need YOU to step up **right now** and help keep this fight going! At **No Dem Left Behind** , we specialize in reaching the voters that many have written off—rural America, Independents, and those fed up with MAGA’s chaos. We know how to connect with them, but we can’t do it without **your continued support**. Right now, we’re asking for your **monthly commitment**. Just $10, $20, or even $50 a month will power the pop-up events, door-knocking campaigns, and face-to-face outreach that wins hearts and minds. We can’t afford to fall behind—not with so much at stake. So, what’s it going to be? Are you with us for the long haul? **Commit today** , and let’s make sure our voices are heard in every corner of the country. **Chip in monthly now** and help fuel the movement that doesn’t quit. [**_These events are expensive and time-consuming, but we have to do this in order to win. Whatever you can give, please do so today. We are going to win, and we are going to do it together._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uxe7b-f6ct3l-kyd76rh6/) Thank you for your continued support, Hassan Martini

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Texas can no longer investigate alleged cases of vote harvesting, federal judge says,"** Texas Tribune's**Xiomara Moore** -- "A federal judge ruled on Saturday that part of a [Texas law](https://substack.com/redirect/68180981-6c6f-488d-a168-10018e9fc56c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that enacted new voting restrictions violated the U.S. Constitution by being too vague and restricting free speech.

The ruling, made by U.S. District Judge **Xavier Rodriguez** , immediately halted the state's ability to investigate alleged cases of vote harvesting, such as the [investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/400c7666-433f-4152-835b-08b974b43420?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into the League of United Latin American Citizens by Attorney General **Ken Paxton**.

Before today's ruling, a person who knowingly provided or offered [vote harvesting services](https://substack.com/redirect/8b980949-3562-403c-b628-a04217702f23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in exchange for compensation was committing a third-degree felony. This meant that organizers of voter outreach organizations and even volunteers could spend up to ten years in prison and fined up to $10,000 for giving or offering these services.

Paxton on Monday [vowed to appeal the ruling](https://substack.com/redirect/7754e8ee-da96-48a5-a209-bfb704062737?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

"A ruling--weeks prior to an election-- preventing my office from investigating potential election violations is deeply troubling and risks undermining public trust in our political process," he said.

According to Republican lawmakers, the provision was put in place to prevent voter fraud and secure election integrity. However, in the ruling, the judge noted that there was widespread confusion about how to implement the canvassing restriction from local election administrators. This confusion also left voter outreach organizations uncertain about whether they could provide volunteers with food or bus fare because it could look like compensation.

This meant that organizers of voter outreach organizations and even volunteers could spend up to ten years in prison and fined up to $10,000 for giving or offering these services.

Paxton on Monday [vowed to appeal the ruling](https://substack.com/redirect/1fd36139-1492-4f21-bdf4-4bfb9636141d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
