The ruling, made by U.S. District Judge Xavier Rodriguez , immediately halted the state's ability to investigate alleged cases of vote harvesting, such as the into the League of United Latin American Citizens by Attorney General Ken Paxton. Before today's ruling, a person who knowingly provided or offered in exchange for compensation was committing a third-degree felony. This meant that organizers of voter outreach organizations and even volunteers could spend up to ten years in prison and fined up to $10,000 for giving or offering these services. Paxton on Monday . "A ruling--weeks prior to an election-- preventing my office from investigating potential election violations is deeply troubling and risks undermining public trust in our political process," he said. According to Republican lawmakers, the provision was put in place to prevent voter fraud and secure election integrity. However, in the ruling, the judge noted that there was widespread confusion about how to implement the canvassing restriction from local election administrators. This confusion also left voter outreach organizations uncertain about whether they could provide volunteers with food or bus fare because it could look like compensation. Many organizations - including La Union del Pueblo Entero, LULAC, and the Mexican American Legal Defense and Educational Fund - have against many other provisions of the law, including voter assistance and mail-in ballot restrictions. The challenges to these provisions have not been ruled on yet. The original complaints were filed in August and September 2021." subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/o_Q-Qlk3j5cVq1OnQpsNPQ~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/o_Q-Qlk3j5cVq1OnQpsNPQ~~/AARclAA~~)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/o_Q-Qlk3j5cVq1OnQpsNPQ~~/AARclAA~~)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/o_Q-Qlk3j5cVq1OnQpsNPQ~~/AARclAA~~)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Conservative Broadcast
---

body:
---
| | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941748/502112756/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=)
---
Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.
[**The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941749/502112757/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=) Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country.
I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me in splitting a donation between him and Katrina Christiansen. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. [**Please let me explain.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941750/502112758/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=)
**[CHIP IN NOW >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941751/502112759/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=)**
---
I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021.
He totally disgraced my home state that day... raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door.
[**But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941752/502112760/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=)
Hawley himself played a major role in overturning Roe V. Wade — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide.
Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book.
It’s just shameful.
**[CHIP IN NOW >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941755/502112761/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=)**
---
[**Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93941756/502112764/-1609757309?amount=10&refcode=20240930_em_fr_b1_katrina_sur_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWFlZjkzMmQtNjU3Zi1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YE4tW28UmncxOSoyjS0XYrjtlPAnfcq2SllM_Wzhjp0=) I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did, from online ads and emails just like this one.
I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. body:
We’re on the frontlines fighting for a blue Senate.
#
Derek,
I recently launched Fetterman’s Frontline Five, a fundraising program supporting our incumbent Democratic Senators who _**_NEED_**_ our full support in this election. 💪
We can’t afford to let MAGA Republicans take over the Senate. There’s too much at stake – from reproductive freedom to LGBTQ+ equality to our federal courts. 🏛️
We have to re-elect Sherrod Brown in Ohio, Jon Tester in Montana, Jacky Rosen in Nevada, Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin, and our own Bob Casey here in PA. 💙
**The FEC’s end-of-quarter deadline is TONIGHT at MIDNIGHT! That means time is running out to help each of the Frontline Five reach their quarterly goals.** **[Can you split a $5 contribution now to support these Democratic champions?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240930?refcode=em20240930-9436&refcode2=9436_434096_t196JW&akid=9436%2E434096%2Et196JW)**

subject: I’m going to do everything I can to win this November.

body:
Our democracy is under threat. Arizona is the front line of that fight. And I am going to do everything I can to make sure that pro-democracy candidates succeed — not only in my home state, but across the country.
#

Friends, it’s Mark.
It wouldn’t surprise me if some of you thought we’d take a break after our campaign in 2020.
Instead, we jumped right back into campaigning for a full term in the U.S. Senate in 2022.
We won in 2020. We won again in 2022. And going into 2024, we are not taking any time off.
Let me make this perfectly clear: I am not done. Not by a long shot.
Our democracy is under threat. Arizona is the front line of that fight. And I am going to do everything I can to make sure that pro-democracy candidates succeed — not only in my home state, but across the country.
I’m going to do everything I can to win this November.
We’re running an important fundraising drive right now, and our deadline is tonight. What we raise ahead of this deadline is going to determine what we can do to take back the House, hold the Senate, and defeat Trump.

subject: do you have some spare change?
body:
Dear Peter,

I wanted to let you know that the deadline for our $125,000 End of Quarter Matching Challenge (doubling all gifts) expires tonight.

And time is running out.

As of now, we've raised $109,493 toward our goal.

With everything that’s at stake in 2024, could you please click here to pitch in $5 or more to help us reach our goal of fulfilling this End of Quarter Matching Challenge
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/yU1RczYGLjY5PRrH-IR99A~~/AAVkMwA~
?

I know $5 may not seem like it can make much of an impact, but it really can.

Let me explain.

A contribution of $5 can pay for a day’s worth of printed materials and a cup of coffee to power our canvassers through a long day of door-knocking.

With teams of canvassers on the ground RIGHT NOW in key targeted Battleground and Referendum States, we need to make sure we educate as many voters as possible about the TRUTH of abortion!

So, a contribution of $5 (which is actually worth $10 thanks to our End of Quarter Matching Challenge) will make an IMMEDIATE impact to keep the Pro-Life Movement fighting.

With everything at stake this year, we simply can’t miss this critical opportunity to raise an additional $125,000 before November to help Students for Life Action keep spreading the TRUTH about abortion to young people.

So, please click here to chip in $5 or more to Students for Life Action IMMEDIATELY
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/sTqtS6VIlSZYnPzNsXMNlg~~/AAVkMwA~
!

Peter, thank you for all you do to support Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Every dollar raised tonight will be reported publicly and will show the strength and momentum of our movement as we push toward victory in November. From strengthening our economy to improving healthcare and ensuring our children have access to quality education, I’m ready to lead this fight in Washington. But I can’t do it alone.

In solidarity,
John

_Issue 126 / September 2024_

| | |
---
USO Supporter, Right now, our heroes are serving in multiple critical situations around the world. In response to rising tensions in the Middle East, the United States is deploying additional service members to the region. At the same time, thousands of National Guard members are supporting communities devastated by Hurricane Helene. This is all on top of the already difficult day-to-day experiences of service members and their families. **The USO is there for service members all around the world, but we need your support to keep operations running. Could you please give $29 to help our heroes in this time of heightened need?** | **[DONATE NOW](https://links.e.uso.)**
---

| | | USO FRONT LINES
---|---

[](https://links.e.uso.)

**How the USO Supports Military Kids**
Going back to school can be a difficult transition for any student. But this time of year is especially difficult for 1.5 million American military children -- many of whom go through three or four school changes before they graduate. [**Learn more about the USO 's programs for military children and their families.**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/YWdETY-aqmBv/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/L3Uvc3ZxeURjcmtRTUJNUTNINGZUSndmY1RPbEJIWkU2MXE4U1VrbTNqakdPMk53M2o5azhGQWo4bmpFLzM1SHREMlNweDhaakZtRVhZZWdyNEtUS01lWXpNRUZRNEdFS0)**[ »](https://links.e.uso.)** ****

[](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/LaXVHgd6_bf-/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/L3Uvc3ZxeURjcmtRTUJNUTNINGZUSndmY1RPbEJIWkU2MXE4U1VrbTNqakdPMk53M2o5azhGQWo4bmpFLzM1SHREMlNweDhaakZtRVhZZWdyNEtUS01lWXpNRUZRNEdFS0)

**USO Rota Staff and Volunteers Greet USS Laboon**
After being out at sea for months, sailors aboard the USS Laboon were welcomed by USO Rota in Spain with coffee, fun and much-needed USO2GO support kits. The fresh coffee with fall flavors was a huge hit!

[**Learn more about how USO2GO supports service members stationed in remote locations without a traditional USO Center.**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/gdYehE~v_9T6/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/L3Uvc3ZxeURjcmtRTUJNUTNINGZUSndmY1RPbEJIWkU2MXE4U1VrbTNqakdPMk53M2o5azhGQWo4bmpFLzM1SHREMlNweDhaakZtRVhZZWdyNEtUS01lWXpNRUZRNEdFS0)**[ »](https://links.e.uso.)** ****

| | | GET INSPIRED
---|---

[](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/q7bgHLqjPpT6/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/)

**USO Helps Pay Tribute to Toby Keith, an American Icon**
Toby Keith went on 18 USO tours, bringing his music and infectious spirit to over a quarter of a million service members around the globe. His performances were more than just concerts -- they were moments of joy, connection and gratitude for those who sacrifice so much for our country.

[**Watch our USO tribute to Toby Keith -- an American icon who embodied the essence of the USO mission. **](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/mWbZT-r0dXc8/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/)**[ »](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/E89~CyNR7-sx/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/)**

| | | GLOBAL ENTERTAINMENT
---|---

[](https://links.e.uso.)

**USO Makes History with Broadway Show on Military Installations**
The USO, in partnership with No Guarantees Productions, brought Broadway to the military with an exclusive live concert version of the Tony Award-winning musical "COME FROM AWAY." This groundbreaking tour performed at three military bases, delivering not just a comical and emotional musical but also a unique and deeply meaningful experience for service members and their families.

[**Learn more about USO Entertainment.**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/dp4vCPKya-c0/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/L3Uvc3ZxeURjcmtRTUJNUTNINGZUSndmY1RPbEJIWkU2MXE4U1VrbTNqakdPMk53M2o5azhGQWo4bmpFLzM1SHREMlNweDhaakZtRVhZZWdyNEtUS01lWXpNRUZRNEdFS0)**[ »](https://links.e.uso.)**

| | |
---
| | | CORPORATE PARTNERS
---|---

**RTX Hosts USO Care Pack Events in Honor of Patriot Day**
The USO and RTX continued their partnership with two care pack events in honor of Patriot Day. As the USO Holiday Care Package Presenting Sponsor, RTX hosted a "Coast to Coast" care pack event at their El Segundo, CA and Andover, MA locations. 250+ RTX employees packed 7,500 USO Holiday Care Packages for service members.

**Join the USO Home Team With a Monthly Gift Today!**
The USO is there for our service members and their families through every step of their military journey, from the moment they enlist through every deployment and as they transition back to civilian life. Giving monthly to the USO means making the biggest difference for America's service members and military families. [**Set up your monthly gift now.**](https://links.e.uso.)**[ »](https://links.e.uso.)**

**Support service members and their families through the Combined Federal Campaign.**
The Combined Federal Campaign (CFC) is the official workplace giving campaign for federal employees and retirees, including members of our military. By supporting the USO through the CFC, you can directly impact the well-being of our nation's service members and their families. [**Learn more about the CFC.**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/2dpGh-ab2zcd/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/L3Uvc3ZxeURjcmtRTUJNUTNINGZUSndmY1RPbEJIWkU2MXE4U1VrbTNqakdPMk53M2o5azhGQWo4bmpFLzM1SHREMlNweDhaakZtRVhZZWdyNEtUS01lWXpNRUZRNEdFS0)**[ »](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/G49Vhw-zDbME/YU5WTTc1Um9JN0h0R2VubDZ1SUZSa25TZFdlUTBQaTBOMkxSaU85SEV2ZEFzUUdRc1IySk0wdE44YUwxekt6U0ljT1piRkJ2UVVwelhTakpDZmptTnU0ZkJadW50RzZTMktqdC9zVk5NMDA9S0/L3Uvc3ZxeURjcmtRTUJNUTNINGZUSndmY1RPbEJIWkU2MXE4U1VrbTNqakdPMk53M2o5azhGQWo4bmpFLzM1SHREMlNweDhaakZtRVhZZWdyNEtUS01lWXpNRUZRNEdFS0)**

Friend,
I apologize that I have had to email you directly, but we are approaching the final deadline of the year and our best chance to make up ground. We are planning to go up with our TV, mail and digital ads, but we are short by $11,739!
The polls show that once the public hears about how radical his opponent is, Jerry wins. Unfortunately, we are still short for the quarter what it will take to get that message out. That's why I need you to please [consider making a last minute donation](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00141_hRdwl-_hzy3rbdXfrDnEcI6Vih-l6Q3x5Bx8_ubsKliwTi3qC2g59yDiWYCkohYM9Mf5YvawbjjOCppGuOp0CJ38KgeRi47Q2r4faBP9JHUVaNNhf0f0TMiPXbICdJX_or03WdcyGhtSmlbd9b4ny-Obl6fYaw421N5ZTZP4y-LVzKdU38Pr9AqGZwmkQLx_3b1ejZWI=&c=HrRjTzSQ273DMA5Z-2VKMhzc9laixXOjQ6SUshqzyG64Em4moU5Kyw==&ch=u9i_SoVf8j3j1xeRlduflvAI6XXU4nbDvAiS9lYsc-UtQbA4xK-UNw==) so we can get rid of a far-left member of Congress and replace him with a common sense, small business owner who will commit to lowering taxes and securing the border while working to drive down inflation for everyone.
I cannot stress enough how important this deadline is for the future of this race and the future of the U.S. Congress. Help us close our fundraising gap by [chipping in $10, $25, $50 or more ](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00141_hRdwl-_hzy3rbdXfrDnEcI6Vih-l6Q3x5Bx8_ubsKliwTi3qC2g59yDiWYCkohYM9Mf5YvawbjjOCppGuOp0CJ38KgeRi47Q2r4faBP9JHUVaNNhf0f0TMiPXbICdJX_or03WdcyGhtSmlbd9b4ny-Obl6fYaw421N5ZTZP4y-LVzKdU38Pr9AqGZwmkQLx_3b1ejZWI=&c=HrRjTzSQ273DMA5Z-2VKMhzc9laixXOjQ6SUshqzyG64Em4moU5Kyw==&ch=u9i_SoVf8j3j1xeRlduflvAI6XXU4nbDvAiS9lYsc-UtQbA4xK-UNw==)before that midnight deadline.
Additionally, consider sending this email out to a few people who could help as well. Every dollar helps us make phone calls, pay for ads and inform voters on what the stakes are in this election cycle.
Thank you for taking the time and please feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
For Freedom and Liberty,
Sallie Nyhan Finance Director Jerry Evans for Congress

body:
| | | Hi team, it's DSCC Chair Gary Peters. As a United States Senator, I've had a front-row seat to the political antics of MAGA Republicans. And I can tell you from experience: **We can't afford to hand them back the majority.**

But experts are saying the GOP is at an advantage this November. On top of that, **our September membership numbers are lagging and putting our majority in danger.**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. | Dear ,
As we enter the final stretch of the campaign, I want to take a moment to express my heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support.
We are working hard every day, winning votes, and spreading our positive message. This past weekend we were out canvassing doors and supporting three homecoming events across the district. On Thursday, we celebrated with Pine-Richland at the “RamFam” event in Pine Park. Then on a busy Friday, we covered Hampton’s Homecoming Tailgate Celebration, Deer Lakes Homecoming Parade, and Pine-Richland’s football game. There were so many wonderful conversations, and the support was tremendous! Congratulations to all the football teams and bands for their outstanding performances on Friday night!

subject: re: Hurricane Helene

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Hurricane Helene made landfall over the weekend, causing historic flooding
and damage to large swaths of the Southeast across six states. Some towns
and cities, like Asheville, North Carolina, were completely underwater,
with roads and bridges wiped out and countless homes destroyed. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140505?t=1002&akid=36034%2E1203867%2E1iRGru ]If you
can, help provide relief to Helene victims now.

Over 100 people are dead, with hundreds more missing and millions without
power. Many are relying on local libraries' wifi networks to contact loved
ones, and some are reporting a lack of access to food, baby formula, and
clean water.

Experts are already saying this was a direct result of the climate crisis
fueled by the fossil fuel industry, which knew about the disastrous
impacts of climate change for at least 50 years and deceived the public,
putting profits over people. These massive oil and gas corporations get
upwards of $20 billion in government subsidies every year, while FEMA
often goes underfunded to properly respond to disasters like Helene.

Places like Asheville — inland mountain towns that many insisted were
immune to climate disasters like Helene — were simply not prepared for
this kind of storm, proving that nowhere is truly safe from the impacts of
climate change, and the negative consequences are not a faraway threat but
an immediate one.

This natural disaster further goes to show the urgency and scale of our
global climate crisis, and our country’s lack of preparedness. It’s
exactly why we need bold climate action through the Green New Deal to end
our reliance on fossil fuels, achieve a clean energy economy that will
generate millions of jobs, and make our nation’s infrastructure resilient
to more extreme weather events. This is a moment for our government to
lead on preventing and protecting us from climate change, and we call on
them to do so.

For now, millions of people are suffering throughout Appalachia and they
need our urgent help. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140505?t=1003&akid=36034%2E1203867%2E1iRGru ]If you can, pitch in a contribution of anything
you can afford to help communities recover from Hurricane Helene here →

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Friend, it's Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez. I'm sure you're flooded with emails today, so I'll get right to the point.
Our last End of Quarter Fundraising Deadline before Election Day is TONIGHT and we need your help to reach our Goal.
I've spent the last two years hard at work making Wisconsin a better place for everyone with Governor Evers. Whether it was vetoing awful Republican bills or redrawing our maps so that everyone has a fair chance at winning this November, we've done everything we can for Wisconsin.
But we want the chance to do far more.
This year's fairer maps give us the chance to build a Democratic majority in both chambers of the state legislature. With that majority, Governor Evers and I would be able to pass our pro-people agenda— but first we need to get active.
We won't win on Election Day by sitting on the sidelines. We have to go to work over these last 36 days talking to voters and spreading our message so that when the dust settles on November 5th, we can focus on making things better, not just protecting our rights and freedoms from Republican attacks.
Friend, I'm focused on helping Democrats up and down the ballot, from Chippewa Falls to Cedarburg and everywhere in between. We're running behind our last End of Quarter Fundraising Deadline before Election Day—can you chip in to help reach our goal? In service,
Lt. Gov Sara Rodriguez
Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband.

Lt. Gov. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products.
Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company.

| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. body:
https://freedomva.org/ [https://freedomva.org/]
“The crisp air of September is a reminder to embrace change like the trees embrace new colors.” -Unknown
As September comes to a close, it's essential to take a moment to reflect on the achievements of our Freedom Virginia Organizing Team. The month of September was definitely a whirlwind of activity with several key organizing projects. We hosted several legislative/constituent events this month focusing on the issues of Prescription Drug Affordability, Housing and shared great personal stories about Sickle Cell Disease.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/20240913_142337.jpg]
Our Organizing Team and Constituent Volunteers meet with Delegate Phil Hernandez
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/20240918_113952_720.jpg]
Delegate Jeion Ward holds a sign encouraging voting during a constituent meeting with our team
https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/642309/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/642309/]
Our Organizing Team and Constituent Volunteers during a meeting with Delegate Kannan Srinivasan
There were huge opportunities for collaboration which resulted in a meeting of organizers from Freedom Virginia, Virginia Community Voice, and Justice4All. That event was one of my favorites as we explore how collaboration with others impacts our goals and amplifies our voices. We hosted a fabulous Storytelling and Advocacy Workshop and some listening opportunities with young voters. Finally, our Lunch and Learn series continues to grow and this month we hosted Dr. LaKeisha Cook from Virginia Interfaith. That Lunch and Learn was so motivating and energizing.
https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/642310/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/642310/]
Thank you to Dr. LaKeisha Cook for leading our Lunch & Learn this month!
This month has been a solid steppingstone toward our goals, and I am excited about the coming weeks and months. Join us when you can.
Eddie Seay
Organizing Director

name: George Whitesides
subject: Running for Congress was never my plan.
body:
Peter,

Running for Congress was never my plan. I never imagined being at this point – less than 40 days until Election Day, facing off against an MAGA Republican in a race that can decide House control.

My entire career has been about serving our community. From serving as Chief of Staff under President Obama, to creating 700+ jobs right here in the Antelope Valley, to co-founding an organization dedicated to solving the wildfire crisis.

Like many of you, I grew tired of Mike Garcia’s extremism. He’s more dedicated to pleasing the far-right reaches of the GOP than delivering for CA-27.

He’s against our best interests – advocating for a national abortion ban with no exceptions, caught up in shady stock dealings, voting to give himself a pay raise but voting against giving firefighters a raise, the list goes on.

We’ve created an incredible coalition to flip this seat. Our hard work is paying off: New polling shows us 1-point ahead of Garcia, and when undecided voters learn about my vision, more support us than him.

That’s why we must meet our FINAL quarterly FEC goal that expires tonight. Keeping our strong momentum is critical this close to Election Day.

Please, chip in $3 or any amount now: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q3-2024?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93950864/502131264/572242427?refcode=em-9.30.24-2-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMmExODdmMC02ZTdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4K1F6hilEmbVoXtJ0ngk4u9x-5WyqzD_atoZRh8O_rE=)**

They’ve seen the polls showing Lucas rapidly gaining ground — cutting Hawley’s double-digit lead to just 4% after being able to air positive TV ads statewide.

Everyone is focused on the presidential polls, but they forget that key statewide races that impact voting rights -- from governor to attorney general to secretary of state to the state supreme court -- are also on the line in a few weeks.

Team: More than 700,000 North Carolinians had their voter registration “purged” before Election Day. The State Elections Board made the announcement of compliance with state law.
This means that North Carolina -- emerging as a crucial state in this year's election -- completed their removal of roughly 10% of their 7.7 million registered voters a little more than a month before the election.
T hese state by state purges, driven by lies and disinformation, often disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . We've seen it reported in other states, like Georgia, and we're sure it's the case in North Carolina this year too.
What can we do about it with just weeks to go and voting already starting? To start, you can ask your friends and family in North Carolina to check their registration status, make sure they are still on the rolls, and make a plan for voting. And we also need your help to stop these purges from happening again.

Peter, In the wake of Hurricane Helene, our communities are facing unprecedented devastation. I extend my deepest condolences to the souls who perished, the families who lost loved ones, and countless lives displaced from their homes. Our beautiful mountain communities are especially reeling, and in desperate need of our support as they navigate the aftermath of this tragedy. I have lived in this state my whole life, and know what it looks like when we band together for our neighbors. **Never underestimate the enduring spirit of North Carolinians. We are resilient, and we will rebuild.** With roadway infrastructures compromised, and many relying on airways or waterways as a means of transportation — there is no shortage of resources needed. There is a massive effort underway to aid the people of Western North Carolina, and every contribution makes a difference. [As we embark on the mission to recover and rebuild from Hurricane Helene, will you please consider a donation to the North Carolina Disaster Relief Fund?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93952814/502134913/1381853763?emci=4aa693e9-c37e-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=bb87c5e1-3a7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=21219833&source=SBD_VF_EM_FR_093024_1_1_HurricaneHelene&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDU4MmU3YS03MDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FQAlRe1n8Qbkyrt6HOsq3AR7UKHqD_NQJrzd3x63w_c=) | [DONATE TO HURRICANE RELIEF](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93952815/502134914/1381853763?emci=4aa693e9-c37e-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=bb87c5e1-3a7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=21219833&source=SBD_VF_EM_FR_093024_1_1_HurricaneHelene&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDU4MmU3YS03MDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FQAlRe1n8Qbkyrt6HOsq3AR7UKHqD_NQJrzd3x63w_c=)

I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about how the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania and the great people of my county helped shape who I am today.

_**I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end.**_

Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5e8b9fad126546e28f0c3ad886b27254&_e=oAH_fVKbEWpJse7k4TEfi_j1NOkqi2hBTkYTXagXrAFL_F2HZxb-Okbc-n2ybWSOzKb-zRWDjsv85O9CuI0VtpMBLSVkUfbJT7RubJfFPsasdeU8bFG9VsnnSzMXafd528YdXbM06856tR9vKcI2T23e-cZt9bFzIMsIyxuHpPD1x6ia_8suPGoTM_biqbpgVXwgWIyQyLCENCxKZUDIvnQN1U0ju2sVsd2V06xv-laqjxv1tAdFcvzOauq01uH0qcZocw-U80RLWHkBIjJuhKklIsnYJRnvRsLszrpUsBBBf8MwTDois3RvyT3l0SyK2and3GbmLfpcM03mqI8s_kpAGSmoMbMNuqvyJTFHX6ocddVEzowEQL8ii_OayT-l38mHJyHJ6A8xVBthC4V_Wg%3D%3D)

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5e8b9fad126546e28f0c3ad886b27254&_e=oAH_fVKbEWpJse7k4TEfi_j1NOkqi2hBTkYTXagXrAFL_F2HZxb-Okbc-n2ybWSOzKb-zRWDjsv85O9CuI0VtpMBLSVkUfbJT7RubJfFPsasdeU8bFG9VsnnSzMXafd528YdXbM06856tR9vKcI2T23e-cZt9bFzIMsIyxuHpPD1x6ia_8suPGoTM_biqbpgVXwgWIyQyLCENCxKZUDIvnQN1U0ju2sVsd2V06xv-laqjxv1tAdFcvzOauq01uH0i2R797Rfigfje2U7ApHZ7s3r3GnQ-j-t0i0N60Guu5VHGuuhLELBt4yt136UgN5D0dmtTZrjl4aqLchVMIrXch943LAWfHapQf7LV_ab7awfd6u6ISX1sMOf8b9PC0WGAIBuCW7m8XgSmrc_R4NdZQ%3D%3D)

**The small rural town of Bloomsburg shaped who I am. I’m proud to be a 7th–generation Pennsylvanian and I’m ready to get to work to help the great people of our state.**

All this is to say, I've lived the American Dream, and I am so grateful for the opportunities that America and Pennsylvania have afforded me.

_**BUT, I am worried that the American Dream is slipping away.**_**Career politicians like my opponent Bob Casey and Kamala Harris are doing NOTHING to stop inflation, allowing rampant crime to go unchecked, and allowing dangerous drugs to cross our borders in excess.** Their policies have made America weaker, and I can't sit back and let that happen. I'm running for U.S. Senate to shake up the status quo.

I know we've only got a little bit of time left until Election Day, and the latest poll has Bob Casey and me in a dead heat. _That 's why every dollar during this final stretch is so important._ We have a chance to send a leader to Washington who will look out for the great people of our state and put Pennsylvanians first.

Thank you,
Dave McCormick

There are _dozens_ of outrageous talking points to analyze from the debate, team, but I want to start with one thing in particular — and it doesn’t involve eating cats and dogs. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/53025?t=7&akid=22181%2E4449941%2EV7vnhn) _“Viktor Orbán, one of the most respected men, they call him a**strongman,** prime minister of Hungary... they said why is the whole world blowing up? Why is it blowing up? He said because ‘**you need Trump as President. They were afraid of him... China was afraid of him. North Korea was afraid of him. Russia was afraid of him...’** Viktor Orbán said it. He said ‘**the most respected, most feared person is Donald Trump. We had no problems when Trump was President.’** ”_ Let’s clarify a few things, team.

The “strongman” who Donald Trump is quoting on the debate stage? _The ultra-conservative prime minister of Hungary who has rolled back human rights, eviscerated their democracy, limited the freedoms of the press, and cozied up to Russia._ Not exactly someone that a candidate for the United States President should be showcasing as a character reference.

There’s a reason why Orbán, Vladimir Putin, and other autocratic leaders around the world are rooting for Trump to take back the White House: **Donald Trump is the greatest threat to democracy — and I’m not just talking about here in the United States.**

As Vice President Kamala Harris said on the debate stage, _**“Those dictators and autocrats are rooting for you to be president again because they’re so clear they can manipulate you with flattery and favors.”**_

Worldwide, democratic countries are terrified of the prospect of a second Trump presidency.

_**And we should be.**_

During his time in the White House, Trump cozied up to Vladimir Putin and the Kremlin. He exchanged love letters with the dictator of North Korea, and he has a warmer relationship with Kim Jong-un than the Canadian Prime Minister. He even threatened to abandon our NATO allies if there was an attack in Europe.

Don’t forget, he extorted Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelenskyy in an effort to get him to smear President Biden — by withholding military aid for their war against Russia. **That led to Trump’s first impeachment — where I investigated him and served as lead impeachment manager in his Senate trial.**

While President Biden and Vice President Harris have worked to restore our country’s standing with our allies, Trump would be like a bull in a china shop on the global stage — much to the delight of autocratic leaders worldwide.

I have stood up against authoritarianism and in support of democracy for my entire career. From my chairmanship of the House Intelligence Committee to leading Trump’s impeachment, to serving on the January 6 Select Committee, **I have always put my oath of office and the Constitution first.**

That’s what this campaign is about — protecting our democracy and building an economy that works for everyone. Bringing truth to light and ensuring autocratic leaders who claim they alone can fix our problems never serve as president.

clean_body: | There are dozens of outrageous talking points to analyze from the debate, team, but I want to start with one thing in particular — and it doesn’t involve eating cats and dogs. “Viktor Orbán, one of the most respected men, they call him astrongman, prime minister of Hungary... they said why is the whole world blowing up? Why is it blowing up? He said because ‘you need Trump as President. They were afraid of him... China was afraid of him. North Korea was afraid of him. Russia was afraid of him...’ Viktor Orbán said it. He said ‘the most respected, most feared person is Donald Trump. We had no problems when Trump was President.’ ” Let’s clarify a few things, team. The “strongman” who Donald Trump is quoting on the debate stage? The ultra-conservative prime minister of Hungary who has rolled back human rights, eviscerated their democracy, limited the freedoms of the press, and cozied up to Russia. Not exactly someone that a candidate for the United States President should be showcasing as a character reference. There’s a reason why Orbán, Vladimir Putin, and other autocratic leaders around the world are rooting for Trump to take back the White House: Donald Trump is the greatest threat to democracy — and I’m not just talking about here in the United States. As Vice President Kamala Harris said on the debate stage, “Those dictators and autocrats are rooting for you to be president again because they’re so clear they can manipulate you with flattery and favors.” Worldwide, democratic countries are terrified of the prospect of a second Trump presidency. And we should be. During his time in the White House, Trump cozied up to Vladimir Putin and the Kremlin. He exchanged love letters with the dictator of North Korea, and he has a warmer relationship with Kim Jong-un than the Canadian Prime Minister. He even threatened to abandon our NATO allies if there was an attack in Europe. Don’t forget, he extorted Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelenskyy in an effort to get him to smear President Biden — by withholding military aid for their war against Russia. That led to Trump’s first impeachment — where I investigated him and served as lead impeachment manager in his Senate trial. name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – September 30th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

*36* days until the election is complete.
October 7th is the last day to register and be able to vote in this
election.
*Double check on VoteTexas.gov! or VoteDenton.gov!*
October 21st marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election
day!
*Make sure you and your circle have your plan to vote!*

*SPECIAL REQUESTS*

*Poll Greeting** gives voters that last show of confidence in their
candidate. I need help because there are 54 early voting sites in Denton
County alone. I’m taking off work but can still only be at one place at a
time. I’d love to have some help, even part time. We can work to guess at
the busiest polling places, busiest days and busiest hours. If you’d like
to help, reply to this email with your contact info and any special notes.
We’ll see how much response we get and try to make a plan. *

*Shirts; We still have some Lineberger light blue T-shirts left after the
UNT and CCA events. Perfect for Poll Greeters, Door knockers, etc.
Inventory now is S - 2, L – 14, XL – 8. I don’t charge for signs or
shirts, but I’m always accepting donations.*

*Signs, Signs, Signs*
*; When we can’t have a poll greeter, the least we can do is to have some
signs at the polling location! This is a very easy job. Wait for the day
before the election. Go to the polling place and place the signs. Check
on the signs a few times to make sure they stay in place. Pick the signs
up when it’s all over. We have a Signup Genius already prepared for 59
Early voting locations including one in Cooke County and several in Wise
County. Some spots are already taken. *Sign Volunteers: Lineberger for US
Congress - Polling Location Sign Placement and Pickup (signupgenius.com)
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0B4BAAAD2FA1FACF8-51480094-lineberger#/>

*The idea is to sign up for a location (or more) not far from you. We also
have sign up open for area coordinators to help people get signs and answer
questions. We may even ask you to install a sign or two for other
candidates at the same polling location. And remember, for early voting,
people can vote anywhere in the county.*

I still have about 155 (of 600) yard signs and 15 larger (2’ x 3’) signs in
stock in my house. Some of these can be for polling locations (120?). I
don’t know how many of you have extra signs lying around. Now is the time
to get them all out so people can see them, learn the name, get curious and
look it up, etc. If you have too many, let us know.

Thank you so much to the teams who have been placing signs. It’s fun to
see them out there.

*Social media*; Since we have such a huge district and won’t be able to
personally call or knock on everyone’s doors, we are trying to find new
ways of getting my name out there and letting people know they’ll have a
‘Better Choice’ this year for Congress.

We are asking that you would please follow "Lineberger for US Congress" on
Facebook. You can also search my name on Twitter (ErnestForTexas),
Instagram (linebergerforuscongress), and/or Tik Tok (@ernestlineberger),
whichever social media platforms you follow. We post several items and
videos each week and would appreciate if you would “like them” and then
“share them” with your friends. Some of you may also have neighborhood
social media platforms where you can share political views, this would also
be a great way to get the word out.

I know some people may be hesitant to do this, but it’s one of the best
ways to multiply our message by a huge amount. For example, there are
almost 1,000 people on our contact list now. If every one of you would post
to your friends (let’s just say 300), that would be 300,000 posts.
Multiplying our efforts to spread the word is truly the only way we will
win. This is such an important election; I hope you’ll commit to doing
that for the next 30 days or until Election Day.

*All of this to try to reach our 300,000-vote win number.*
Hopefully, after seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach
out to you and us for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure
people that we are for real. *When that opportunity comes your way, make
it count*!

Here is what’s coming up soon, plus major events up to the election.

*Tuesday, Oct 1st*, 7:30 pm, VP Debate Watch Party, Brass Tap, Highland
Village
Mobilize link to sign up and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/703596/

*Thursday, Oct 3rd*, 6:30 pm, Robson Ranch monthly meeting, Ernest to speak

*Date Time and Format uncertain:* LISD Candidate Forum, Lewisville High
School or video only?
-My understanding is that I will provide my answers on video.
Still waiting for questions.

*Friday, Oct 4th*, Interview with Star-Telegram Editorial Board with
opponents for possible endorsement (online)

*Saturday, Oct 5th*, 9 am – noon, Block Walk, The Colony
Mobilize link to sign up and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/702243/

*Saturday, Oct 5th*, 5 – 10 pm, Denton County Indian Cultural Association,
DANDIYA Night, McKamy Middle School

*Sunday, Oct 6th*, 2 – 5 pm, Lantana Area Dem’s Election Kickoff,
Bartonville
Mobilize link to sign up and details: https://mobilize.us/s/kvSKUq

*Monday, Oct 7th*, 6:30-8:30 pm, Meet & Greet at a private home

*Thursday, Oct 10th*, 7 pm, LWV Voucher Forum, Texas Oncology Denton

*Friday, Oct 11th*, 10 – 11 am (event goes longer), Daily Bread Open House,
909 N Loop 288, Denton

*Friday, Oct 11th*, Interview with Dallas Morning News with opponents for
possible endorsement

*Saturday, Oct 12th*, 9 am – noon, Block Walk, TBD

*Saturday, Oct 12th*, 10 am – 5 pm, Cooke County Depot Days

*Sunday, Oct 13th*, 1:30-2:30 pm, RADD (Sanger Dems) monthly meeting

*Sunday, Oct 13th*, 4:30 - 7 pm, Dems of 380 candidate event in Silverado

*Tuesday, Oct 15th*, 5:30 – 8:30 pm, Prestonwood Candidate Forum and Mixer,
6801 W Park Blvd, Plano

*Sunday, Oct 15th*, 7 pm, Colin Allred – Ted Cruz senatorial Debate on WFAA
or WFAS?

*Monday, Oct 21st*, 7 am, Early Voting Begins!!! - Poll Greeting daily
(Will need lots of help to staff the major polling sites)

*Friday, Nov 1st*, 7 pm, Early Voting Ends

*Saturday, Nov 2nd*, 11 am, Denton Women’s March – followed by block
walking TBD

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, 7 am – 7 pm, Election Day – Poll Greeting (Will need
even more help with even more polling sites)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, Election Night Watch Party, Union Bear Brewing Company,
215 S Bell Ave, Denton
Mobilize link to sign up and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/670137/

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

If you check the calendar, tomorrow isn’t just October 1st. It’s also the day our two Vice Presidential Candidates debate.
#
Peter,
This is it. Today is our final quarterly FEC deadline of this election.
Tomorrow we begin our last, full month until the election.
And we need you to make a donation before midnight. It’s what we need to hit the ground running and fully fund our programs in what promises to be a critical home stretch.
If that’s all you need to hear, please: [**Use this link to make a donation of whatever you can afford to give.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24.0zv8Fz&refcode=em240930-1-30&t=1&akid=30111%2E3013755%2EyUuB16)**

---
If you need to hear a little more before you’re ready to chip in, read on. We’re happy to explain why your donation — especially today — is so important to our organization.
If you check the calendar, tomorrow isn’t just October 1st. It’s also the day the Vice Presidential Candidates debate.
Tim Walz is one of VoteVets’ own. He served decades in the Guard. And we want to emphasize a few things before that debate.
When Tim announced his first campaign for Congress it was a long shot. No doubt. He didn’t have many people backing him up, and even fewer were willing to put up the money it takes to set up a candidate for success.
But when we met Tim we knew he was the real deal. We put $100,000 into his first race. He won, and he’s kept winning. And now, he will be the next Vice President of the United States.
Take that example — one good man going from a first-time candidate to the nominee for Vice President — and expand that out to the thousands of candidates that VoteVets is backing just this year. From School Board up to Senate. Our people — Veterans, National Security Professionals, Patriots — are the future.
Tomorrow we’re all going to look at what we’ve raised and decide what we can put down to hold the Senate, take back the House, make sure Kamala Harris and Tim Walz defend the White House... and invest in the candidates who are going to lead our party and our nation for the next decade.
Whatever we raise we will put towards those objectives.
That’s why today is such a critical day to make your first donation. So, if you’re ready:
[**We’re humbly asking you to please chip in $3 or whatever you can afford to VoteVets before our deadline at midnight. No donation is too small. Anything you can give matters and will have an immediate impact.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24.0zv8Fz&refcode=em240930-1-30&t=3&akid=30111%2E3013755%2EyUuB16)**

Peter — Scott
here, Tammy’s campaign manager.

Last week, we made a difficult decision. We decided to increase our
September advertising budget so we could go up with a new round of ads.
The money wasn’t in the budget, but I gave the green light anyway.

Why? Because Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have spent more than $50
million to flood the airwaves with nasty, misleading ads attacking Tammy —
and there’s more to come, with Mitch McConnell’s super PAC announcing an
eight-figure ad buy in Wisconsin.

Their strategy is working too, with four recent polls showing this race
statistically tied.

So after a lot of discussion with Tammy and the rest of the team, we
signed off on a new round of ads to fight back against these brutal
attacks and set the record straight. Since these new ads weren’t
originally in our budget, we had to raise our September fundraising goal
to help cover the difference.

We’re taking a big risk, I know. But it’s a gamble we had to make in order
to make sure these Republican attacks don’t go unanswered. Anything less,
and Hovde would continue to inch ahead in this toss up race.

So today, before our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of this
election, I’m hoping we can count on you to help us close the gap and
reach our target.

name: Sri Kulkarni
subject: 28 Days, 3 Steps to Win: No Donation, Just Action! 🌟
body:
Explore simple, impactful actions we can take together this month to win this November! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/054f915a30c2/28-days-3-steps-to-win-no-donation-just-action?e=b4b662832c)
---
| | | | |
## 28 Days, 3 Steps to Win: No Donation, Just Action! 🌟
---
| With less than a month to go, everyone is asking you to rush a donation. That’s NOT what I’m asking you to do. I am asking **YOU** to help win this election by doing the most effective thing you can, and I’m going to make it as simple as possible:**3 Easy Steps:**
1. **Download an app** that lets you build a personal network of people you know who are registered to vote, and join the campaigns of the states where they live. Here’s the app: [https://reach.vote/dl](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=5444b06328&e=b4b662832c)
2. **Add 50 or more people to your network** from a swing state (MI, PA, WI, NC, GA, NV, or AZ) and **survey them.** (Ask them to make sure they have a plan to vote, and vote our way.) Here’s a link to a video on how to do that: [https://bit.ly/FriendbankVideo](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=0b520c387b&e=b4b662832c)
3. **Get at least 1 of those people to do what you just did.** Here’s a link for nightly training at 8PM ET [bit.ly/ReachSwingStates](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=8e17b4322f&e=b4b662832c) (for you or your friend in a swing state). If you can’t find 50 people you know in a swing state, **at least do #3 and find one person in a swing state who will do this.** (And if you really can’t think of a single person you know in a swing state, you can still [support the effort here](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=f74cc36ca4&e=b4b662832c).)

That’s it! That’s the whole program! It’s at once surprisingly simple, but also the most effective thing we can do. And if you don’t believe me, here’s some simple math. Over 75% of people never answer a cold call. So that’s over 120 million voters we CANNOT reach through the old phonebanks we've been doing for years.
If each volunteers just did this, and could find **FIVE EXTRA VOTES EACH** out of 50 personal contacts (very easy to do), this is what we would get:
* 5,400 volunteers x 5 PA votes each = 27,000 votes
(more than how much Trump won by)
* 4,600 volunteers x 5 WI votes each = 23,000 votes
(more than how much Trump won by)
* 2,200 volunteers x 5 MI votes each = 11,000 votes
(more than how much Trump won by)

There are over 500,000 volunteers right now nationwide! We **have** the people, but we need to give them the tools so they can reach out to people **they know** , who will answer their calls, not just ask them to make cold calls. This isn't rocket science. But, we do have to stop using old technology if we are going to win the war 2024.
Sincerely,
Sri

---
| P.S. if the times above don’t work, we have more trainings available for every swing state:
[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStates](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=cdc1b397ef&e=b4b662832c)[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStatesMI](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=89192785c5&e=b4b662832c)[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStatesNV](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=c811a31dab&e=b4b662832c)[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStatesPA](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=2edc4f7a00&e=b4b662832c)[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStatesAZ](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=58f5c14ffe&e=b4b662832c)[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStatesWI](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=2d960c5bfd&e=b4b662832c)[https://bit.ly/ReachSwingStatesNC](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=10b4829bd5&e=b4b662832c)

Fellow American,

It's simple.

We cannot fix Washington without independent, common sense leaders who bring
people together.

I'm running for Senate because Washington is broken, and I'm ready to get
right to work with bipartisan, common sense solutions to finally fix the mess.

But with my race in a deadlock, Marylanders already beginning to cast their
votes, and my final FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline just hours away,
pulling off a victory will require all hands on deck.

Can I count on your support before my official FEC deadline tonight at
midnight?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aafc_acs&amtposition=2>

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aafc_acs&amtposition=2>
Extreme partisanship and inaction have held us back for too long. Many
Washington politicians simply choose to argue with each other instead of
getting anything done for the people.

With your help, we can send a loud and clear message to all the politicians
in Washington that will be heard all across America this November.

Please consider chipping in your most generous contribution to my campaign
today. We’re running out of time to reach our fundraising goal before our final
FEC deadline. Anything you can give makes an important difference right now.

This is a grassroots movement, and we rely on people like you to fuel our
campaign.

Thank you,
Gov. Larry Hogan

A Personal Message from Governor Larry Hogan:

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aafc_acs&amtposition=2>
Hi, it’s Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve
to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight
years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough
decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of
President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal
considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and
willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it’s not in
my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I
can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I’m under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I’m no stranger to
uphill battles, and I know I can’t do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

It’s no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington
partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I’m the underdog in this
race. And that’s why your support TODAY is so crucial.

So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in
helping me continue building a strong campaign.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aafc_acs&amtposition=2>

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation
didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results! Let’s get back to work
again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across
the country!
Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aafc_acs&amtposition=2>
Thank you,
Larry Hogan

Beth Van Duyne is running for Congress because she knows the people of the 24th District deserve to have a strong, principled voice in Congress. She’s been asked what prompted her to run for public office; the answer is simple – her children. We live in a very fragile time for our nation, our families, and the future of the American Dream. Socialism is on the rise, our border crisis has never been worse, and we face constant threats from hostile nations willing to use cyber-attacks, nuclear weapons, and terrorist jihad. When Beth thinks about her two children, she wants them to have the same opportunities in life that she did; She wants them to be able to grow up safe and proud of our country. Beth is a single mom, a conservative Republican, a reformer who has defeated government corruption, a believer in the rule of law who has helped remove thousands of criminal aliens from North Texas, a leader who helped deliver growth and new job opportunities, and a Constitutionalist who has never backed down when it comes to protecting the rights of all North Texans. | Paid for by Beth Van Duyne for Congress

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3854a3bf748246afb2af67ab4aeb4f1d&_e=hyQElf4Xg5duGT2y2AUnpFLAWttdHEcQbTQ2CRe_IHdTw90qgrtFLQF0Mvctm_OWvSV8nre7ylUGR42LgiXIYkQZ-bn7kTrFPm0R0aKB3dA5FleSV-OBMgDphg7f0mU2DacNmNpdPIt4_sQQdSwKT5CEFcKSMo1vsJTYWOGU4eNQt_1IJaOp7QA3q-pmuGRy9ynGOuMKuG2U-NofRQEp7ts7VyZVbwFZbQaa1iV_Mn3-5E687jlEODAeHNYbIOZ0qC5J7Zg5LC0KZ_iIDUw7Ut2XRz9CQUFSrX4WDYPX8xH7s2uOZ2ca_2W4n45XJFx7TFYOVkmCgjQrSgiYUKLDySimNXcFjo9gc85KJxn42bmAQc8_CwkBEEGvWs3JUzmIqee3n1_Fkkbgqf-KP5PUYY30bCFieWONJs6s5thMAFA%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I know you’re busy, but I had to reach out
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Today, I found myself thinking about my recovery journey and the GIFFORDS community.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240930-2-30&t=1&akid=9088%2E3935704%2ExHmQyM)
---
Hi there, it’s Gabby Giffords. I know you’re busy, so I’ll try to keep this brief. I wanted to reach out to you personally because today I have been reflecting on my recovery journey and the work the GIFFORDS community has accomplished together.
Thirteen years ago, I was shot in the head while meeting with constituents in Tucson, Arizona. I’ve been in recovery every single day since. I often think about my recovery the same way I think about our movement to end gun violence: some days are more difficult than others.
The work we do to fight for a future free from gun violence is challenging. Believe me, I feel that struggle right alongside you. But I also take time to celebrate the days when our progress is tangible—like last week when President Biden signed comprehensive new gun safety executive orders into law. I hope you do too.
We have come such a long way in our movement in the past eleven years since GIFFORDS was founded, and it never could have happened without the support of people like you. That is why I need to ask for your help again today.
In just a few hours, we’ll be closing the books on our September quarterly FEC fundraising drive. This is our final quarterly fundraising deadline before Election Day, which means it’s one of our last chances to raise the resources we need to support our endorsed gun safety champions—from Vice President Kamala Harris at the top of the ticket all the way down to state and local races across the nation.
[**Gun safety candidates nationwide are counting on our help. So please, can I ask you to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC—of $3 or any amount that makes sense for you—before our FEC deadline passes at midnight?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240930-2-30&t=2&akid=9088%2E3935704%2ExHmQyM)

We launched a brand new ad, but we don’t exactly have enough money in the budget for it. **[I’m about to explain why I made this risky decision – but if you’re short on time, will you split $10 now between my campaign and Lucas Kunce to help us keep our ads on the air?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74496?refcode=em20240930-7877&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7877%2E614464%2E8YLNSw)**

The people of New Jersey deserve a choice for what kind of public servant they have in the Senate.
**Tonight is our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the election — and it's a**** _big_****one.**
This end-of-quarter deadline will be a true test of our campaign's grassroots strength because at midnight tonight, the books will close, and soon, our fundraising numbers will become public to everyone. [**We need to show that our movement is unstoppable in the final weeks of this race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93959507/502152229/-1197072038?refcode=2024-09-30-eoq&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=b991c19f-7d7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOTkxYzE5Zi03ZDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U2qQgRGSrHUUrBkMN5Ncron483wJ13G0J9RssqE3KZs=)
Right now, a staggering 84 percent of people in New Jersey believe NJ politicians are corrupt. The people of New Jersey deserve a choice for what kind of public servant they have in the Senate.
**Instead of throwing up my hands and giving up, I am stepping up to show that there is a better way.** We deserve leaders who can serve with integrity. Leaders who are workhorses, not show horses. After Menendez's scandal, we need a fresh start — a chance to lift up a new generation of leadership that can bring a new voice and deep public service experience to the U.S. Senate.
Defending democracy isn't just about defeating Donald Trump and MAGA extremism in November – both of which are hugely important. It also involves restoring trust in our elected officials to do the right thing. I'm fighting to restore integrity to our politics, because for too long, politicians have put themselves over the people. **It's time to fix that.**
**While some would have you believe that corruption and greed are an inescapable part of politics — I firmly reject that notion, and so should you.**
Right now, we need to show that we're bringing a different kind of politics to New Jersey – we can do that now by rejecting the hate and division we're seeing from MAGA politicians and elect leaders who will unite us and work toward a better future. **We are building up a powerful movement for change, and we need you.**
[**So before our final end-of-quarter deadline of the election, I'm asking you to pitch in whatever is meaningful to you and help our team show our grassroots strength and propel this movement forward in the final weeks of the race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93959514/502152232/-1197072038?refcode=2024-09-30-eoq&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=b991c19f-7d7f-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOTkxYzE5Zi03ZDdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U2qQgRGSrHUUrBkMN5Ncron483wJ13G0J9RssqE3KZs=)
