name: Adam Schiff
subject: We can turn this ship around
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=7797%2E5257348%2EcrDTIV)
In recent days, you’ve heard a lot from me and my team, Derek.
I’ll tell you why. I’m running for Senate because I want to get real things done for all Californians. But I also **truly believe that our democracy is in trouble.**
In the last eight years, we have seen things take place in this country that I never would have imagined in America — an attempted insurrection, the GOP devolving into a destructive cult of personality around a deeply immoral figure, and some of our most precious freedoms stripped away by a Supreme Court packed with partisan and reactionary justices.
**But I want you to know that I remain optimistic about our future.** We are a deeply resilient country, and we will get through this. There will come a time when we look back on this period of history and wonder how someone like Donald Trump ever became president. How soon we get to that point, however, depends on us. It depends on the kind of effort we make in the next few weeks to move this country in the right direction. And having another staunch defender of our democracy in the Senate is essential.
At midnight, we will reach our FEC fundraising deadline, after which our fundraising numbers will be made public. And emails like these help us raise money to fight back against the cult of the former president. You see, whether you donate $3, $5, or $10, it all adds up and gets us closer to winning this Senate seat, sending Kamala Harris to the White House, and getting real things done.
And you know what else? **MAGA Republicans will be studying these reports looking for any weakness in our campaign.** They are terrified that I’ll be elected to the Senate because I have a track record of holding the corrupt accountable, and they know they are next. And they know we see real opportunities in California to make gains and flip the House.
**So I’m asking, will you please give what you can to help us end this quarter strong? Here’s a link you can use:[secure.actblue.com/donate/sept2024_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240930_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=4&akid=7797%2E5257348%2EcrDTIV)**
Derek, as I said, I truly believe that our democracy is on fragile ground.
But I also believe that with the support of this team behind me, we will restore our freedoms, defeat the cult of the former president, and bring real change to America.
— Adam

Hey Peter,
I wanted to reach out personally and give you one more opportunity to contribute before the clock strikes midnight and we report our fundraising numbers to the FEC.
We’re getting close to our goal, but we’ve got about $1,985 left to raise in the final hours. Can you step up before our deadline tonight and chip in whatever you can? Here’s a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q3-2024**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93960514/502155629/645503820?refcode=em-9.30.24-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNzlmZjRiZi03ZjdmLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bUFV9pyCPMOgACdZzfhdAgVsVVp6K1a4qWIzr3j8gNc=)
Make no mistake: I’m the only candidate running to represent WI-03 who really cares about working-class people. Because I am one. I’m in this to help solve the real problems we face, from the high cost of housing and groceries to the affordability of healthcare.

We’re all getting bombarded with political ads, mailers, and phone calls as the election gets closer. But in the end, the future of our country may come down to you and your story.

clean_body: We can’t risk a fundraising failure this close to the election, but if things don’t turn around today, that's exactly what we will face. | FUNDRAISING CRISIS I can’t stress this enough, Fellow American. I am facing a severe fundraising crisis when I can least afford to fall behind. We are currently $3,802 behind our fundraising goal for the third quarter of 2024. Our goal is $8,000; we have yet to break $5,000, and we only raised $1,415 last week! If I don’t catch up and close this concerning fundraising shortfall, I will have to cancel pre-planned ad campaigns and grassroots events in Texas. We can’t afford to dial back our campaign with 36 days until Election Day. We need to build our campaign and spread my message across the DFW region to reach the most voters. I believe adhering to conservative principles and Texas values will help steer the American ship out of this treacherous storm of Democrat’s making. But I need you standing with me to fund this campaign so my talented staff can maximize my message and reach the critical voters who are least likely to vote by Election Day. If Adams fights this, odds are he will win. But he has already been tarnished as a crook, and he will have to spend millions in legal fees to fight these prosecutorial fascists.

Liberals are now complaining about "misinformation" as if people don't have the right to be misinformed. Energy Czar John Kerry wants to legally harass people who question the climate change agenda, while he tools around in a fossil fuel guzzling yacht.
Trump has expressed sympathy for Adams and if he can win this election, perhaps he may be able to force the corrupt Justice Department to drop the case. Our politicians, whether liberal or conservative, should be allowed to represent their constituency as they wish without being attacked by a weaponized Justice Department.

| | China unveiled the designs for its mission to the moon at the end of last week. You’re probably wondering why that matters to you, especially when we have a laundry list of problems here at home. Whether or not China makes it to the moon by 2030, the fact they’re trying says all we need to know about their competition with the US. We have the technology, creativity, innovation, and ambition to take our country into the future, by and with our own hands. Yet for too long Washington has put our future in the hands of the Chinese Communist Party, making us more reliant on their supply chains and more vulnerable to their political whims, all while making us less competitive, poorer, and more divided at home. This must stop. We don’t have to have a plan to return to the moon (though we do have one), but we need to reinvest here at home in Michigan and across America, and that starts by winning in November.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

body:

|
---

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=276635f39a074491aa5a5af6b83a4ce7&_e=u2WC6wieH9rc_JRCZmN-rk7cHudBCyCE0cmBequ22BWDswUH5WesDHfqrzA2MQ_2wUZ5Tk04TfIFw2YWZ59vsMA7pDuzuiEyOim0BX1wifPWa7CuM7nfaYl62dfWWu83rqpXZ2BdC6G-DxUvqJ-NRDBLAS8iZidAUqDnxznHlxp3iyGUMPK3w2gku2lf2_JXNDMjvR8yXCJlfORQiirp0EgW2gW0lKO3c1-Gxqd4lidl5mVBbfjj4DkTaHQWiimttS3fpVBISXu9ILH9As9SRn1qdeAWRBEHTS21KQlS0btEpr_YuIOFDZ751O5eY7GUbilGS-Y3Hbck8hUnP-pkzA%3D%3D)
Hey,

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you, Fellow American.

I'm a little anxious about opening up to you this way, but I've worked my entire life to overcome my anxiety, so here we are.

**It 's the fourth quarter, and the Dems are putting a full-court press on us. My back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything.**

My name is Royce White. You might not know me, but I'm a professional basketball player who saw huge success in college, got drafted to the NBA, and put it all behind me to fight for players' mental health policy. I left the NBA to play in Canada, and now play professionally in the BIG 3 Tournament.

**I 'm also the GOP Candidate in a MUST-WIN race for Minnesota's next United States Senator, a race that could decide who controls Washington, D.C.**

Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have already raised over $500 MILLION to trash GOP Candidates and cling to power. Money that will go directly to my liberal opponent, Amy Klobuchar.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=276635f39a074491aa5a5af6b83a4ce7&_e=u2WC6wieH9rc_JRCZmN-rk7cHudBCyCE0cmBequ22BWDswUH5WesDHfqrzA2MQ_2wUZ5Tk04TfIFw2YWZ59vsMA7pDuzuiEyOim0BX1wifPWa7CuM7nfaYl62dfWWu83rqpXZ2BdC6G-DxUvqJ-NRDBLAS8iZidAUqDnxznHlxp3iyGUMPK3w2gku2lf2_JXEMIhlnqgCvXc5z9ydX_mI0RYOnezCCL9x4jngs5ExPQ7aa9jOBDWrCPRQqDMGZijVpIAjZxSMEH7Mg6SdjoiMQNV4uGwN2jub0Hv-a-VEylt5-1-tIZFpaNxSINXfag65IfpEhldscuwDLopc3FK0w%3D%3D)
The Industrial Media Complex thinks I can't win this race, but I bet you've heard that one before.

It's really hard to ask for help like this, but starting a grassroots campaign is incredibly difficult.

Biden, Harris, Walz, and Klobuchar won't stop pressing us. America-First Patriots like you and me - they hate us.

[**Will you please have my back on this one and pass me an assist?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=276635f39a074491aa5a5af6b83a4ce7&_e=u2WC6wieH9rc_JRCZmN-rk7cHudBCyCE0cmBequ22BWDswUH5WesDHfqrzA2MQ_2wUZ5Tk04TfIFw2YWZ59vsMA7pDuzuiEyOim0BX1wifPWa7CuM7nfaYl62dfWWu83rqpXZ2BdC6G-DxUvqJ-NRDBLAS8iZidAUqDnxznHlxp3iyGUMPK3w2gku2lf2_JXgbs92cwmT_lOLluUqWPk70ctnLt-QHSOFXr-l3EUxBizhQe9mEc9eFeloyH2Z_2L-0XB1W2iWnFdMzNSti4a2-qiRYRjTaJoFkDwpALxZIKCm2K9mIq-gf5p9vtwXLLFjzsup_JNMDObLXXQ586GcQ%3D%3D)
| [ **RUSH YOUR SUPPORT** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=276635f39a074491aa5a5af6b83a4ce7&_e=u2WC6wieH9rc_JRCZmN-rk7cHudBCyCE0cmBequ22BWDswUH5WesDHfqrzA2MQ_2wUZ5Tk04TfIFw2YWZ59vsMA7pDuzuiEyOim0BX1wifPWa7CuM7nfaYl62dfWWu83rqpXZ2BdC6G-DxUvqJ-NRDBLAS8iZidAUqDnxznHlxp3iyGUMPK3w2gku2lf2_JX7QrlaiUigXhR7MaeK04b2M3KqnIA8RpNDdc2mmzCcJI8XGwrKAf2Rg08s5XX-nQSR8IzM8_rYikqNhsE81beUAvc0_32jEcn59nNj6CtG-a-OQcx8Dn_KodPXU7OKgs5dVerXBkPdKEapdukU4T-1w%3D%3D)
---

I know, I'm not a politician. I know I don't have the typical background of someone running for the United States Senate. But, maybe that's a good thing. I'm not a career politician; I'm an American looking for change.

The status quo has led us to one of the most dangerous times in American History. Our border is wide open, elected officials continue spending taxpayer money that we don't have, and we're on the brink of World War III.

[**So, I 'm opening up to you today, hoping you'll stand with me.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=276635f39a074491aa5a5af6b83a4ce7&_e=u2WC6wieH9rc_JRCZmN-rk7cHudBCyCE0cmBequ22BWDswUH5WesDHfqrzA2MQ_2wUZ5Tk04TfIFw2YWZ59vsMA7pDuzuiEyOim0BX1wifPWa7CuM7nfaYl62dfWWu83rqpXZ2BdC6G-DxUvqJ-NRDBLAS8iZidAUqDnxznHlxp3iyGUMPK3w2gku2lf2_JXOI21EUir3S6LM_ln51YvVQETGlJJAA3HDsaZMVEKDgkuCNUfjCmY8cGV2Ox4soCG5f6qzwCdywj3dNi0FpBZnazS0-DHUOFVakdwvYqjdvuIpS9PmYC_46oYZcXboZ2AUEa0x4b5sTOyzY8UD_hq7g%3D%3D)

Thank you,

Royce White
GOP America-First Candidate for Senate
